blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World models are evaluated by predicting future observations from actions. These evaluations assume that actions are prepared the same way as during training, but an unchecked mismatch can make a model appear less accurate than it is. We audit this assumption in Navigation World Models (NWM) and find three interacting differences between its training and rollout code. Correcting the inputs, without retraining, reduces mean visual prediction error by 42%, measured with DreamSim on the RECON navigation dataset. The correction also changes the ranking of NWM checkpoints in an exploratory analysis and removes or reduces two alternative models' measured advantages. Correcting only the normalization offset instead increases error, showing why interacting mismatches must be checked together. To test whether sensitivity to input preparation extends beyond NWM, we deliberately introduce encoding errors into two alternative models; both become less accurate. We introduce ActRosetta, a tool that checks whether action encoding matches training, identifies supported causes of disagreement, and repairs inputs when sufficient information is available. Repair helps little where predictions barely respond to actions, the tool's diagnosis has limited coverage, and improved control remains unproven. For any action-conditioned world model, the lesson is the same: before reporting rollout error, verify that evaluation encodes actions exactly as training did.
blocks.zh: 通过预测未来对行动的观察来评估世界模型。 这些评价假定,行动是在培训期间以同样的方式准备的,但不加控制的不匹配会使模型看起来不如实际准确。 我们在导航世界模型(NWM)中审计这一假设,发现其培训和推出代码之间存在三个相互作用的差异. 校正输入,不进行再培训,在RECON导航数据集上用DreamSim测量,将平均视觉预测误差减少42%. 更正还改变了NWM检查站在探索性分析中的排名,并去除或减少两个备选模式的衡量优势。 只纠正正常化反而会增加出错,表明为什么必须一起检查相互作用的不匹配。 为了测试对输入制备的敏感度是否超越了NWM,我们特意将编码错误引入了两个替代模型;两者都变得不太准确. 我们提出《罗塞塔法案》,这是一个工具,用以检查行动编码是否与培训相匹配,查明出现分歧的辅助原因,并在获得足够信息时修复投入。 修复对于预测几乎无法响应动作的地方帮助不大,工具的诊断范围有限,改进的控制仍未得到证实. 对于任何有行动条件的世界模式,教训是一样的:在报告推出错误之前,核实评价对行动的编码与培训完全一样。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World models are evaluated through rollouts : starting from real camera frames of a recorded robot run, or trajectory , the model receives the run’s actions and predicts the frames that follow, each prediction feeding the next. Evaluations use segments of trajectories, called clips . We study Navigation World Models (NWM) [ 5 ] , a model that predicts future camera frames from past frames and navigation actions; later work reuses its rollout code, so one error can affect several evaluations. Preprocessing maps poses to action inputs, choosing a reference frame, a normalization offset, an angle convention and a rule for aggregating raw-step displacements. This action encoder has no learned weights: it is neither NWM’s image encoder nor its learned action embedding. A difference between the encodings used in training and in evaluation is a mismatch ; the error it causes is charged to the model.
blocks.zh: 通过推出评价世界模式: 从一个记录的机器人运行或轨迹的真实相机帧开始,模型接收了运行的动作并预测了随后的帧,每一个预测反馈到下一个. 评价使用轨迹的片段,称为片段。 我们研究"导航世界模型"(Naving World Models (NWM) [5]),这个模型从过去的相机帧和导航动作中预测出未来的相机帧;后期工作重新使用其推出代码,因此一个错误可以影响几个评价. 预处理地图为行动投入提供参考,选择一个参考框架、一个正常化抵消、一个角度惯例和一个汇总原步移位的规则。 这个动作编码器没有学到的分量:它既不是NWM的图像编码器,也不是其学到的动作嵌入. 培训和评价中使用的编码的不同之处在于不匹配;它造成的错误被充电到模型上.

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks ask whether a model follows the action it is given [ 42 , 8 , 9 ] ; we ask whether the model received the action it learned to interpret. Our main result is an audit of NWM’s action interface: its released rollout code prepares actions differently from its training code, through three interacting mismatches that change one frozen checkpoint’s predictions (Figure 1 ). We call the action inputs built by the released rollout code released actions , and those built from the same poses by the training code repaired actions ; replacing one with the other, with the checkpoint unchanged, is repair . A chunk spans one prediction call, which predicts one future state a fixed time shift ahead. The two encodings agree only on the first chunk, so a one-chunk check passes.
blocks.zh: 现有的基准询问一个模型是否遵循它所赋予的行动[42,8,9];我们询问该模型是否接受了它所学到的解释行动. 我们的主要结果是对NWM的行动界面进行审计:它发布的推出代码准备的行动与其培训代码不同,通过三个相互作用的错配来改变一个被冻结的检查站的预测(图1)。 我们称,由已发布的推出码构建的动作输入释放出动作,而由训练码构建的相同外观的动作修复了动作;取而代之的是另一个,检查站不变的,正在修复。 一个块跨越一个预言呼叫,它预言一个未来状态将会有固定的时间转移。 两种编码只同意第一个块,所以一个一卡通的检查通过.

blocks.en: Detecting that two action encoders differ is differential testing; knowing what to fix is harder, because mismatches interact: fixing only NWM’s offset increases error. The encoding also spans the rollout loop, dataset code and normalization, so reading one function can miss what the model receives. We therefore query action encoders, with a tool we call ActRosetta. Our NWM repair itself used NWM’s own training code; ActRosetta lets others run the same check on their own encoders. Our contributions are: 1. An action-interface mismatch that changes model evaluation. NWM’s rollout code differs from training in reference frame, normalization offset and yaw wrapping. Repair, without retraining, reduces mean DreamSim error on RECON from 0.240 to 0.139 (42%) and removes or shrinks two alternative models’ leads (Sec. 3 ). 2. A repeatable audit with witnessed attribution. ActRosetta queries paired training and evaluation encoders on controlled paths, names a differing field only when a test path witnesses it, and repairs only when the whole contract, an encoder’s full set of encoding choices, is determined. Unlike ActionABI [ 2 ] , which shares its principles but recovers contracts from logs, it diagnoses paired code, identifying the interacting choices a patch must address (Secs. 4 – 5 ). 3. Evidence separating detection, attribution and repair. ActionFaultBench, our benchmark of action-encoder pairs whose differences are known in advance, tests whether a checker can find differences, explain them and recover the training encoder’s inputs, on four sealed test sets written by separate automated agents after our code was frozen; an audit of 40 public repositories complements it. On the final 240-pair test, ActRosetta detects all 91 differing pairs, recovers their differences exactly in 73 cases, and repairs all 38 differing pairs supported by output conversion (Secs. 6 – 7 ).
blocks.zh: 检测到两个动作编码器不同是差分测试;知道什么是更难解决的,因为不匹配相互作用:只修复 NWM 的抵消会增加出错. 编码还跨越了推出的回路,数据集代码和常态,因此读取一个函数可以错过模型得到的东西. 因此,我们查询动作编码器, 我们称之为Act Rosetta的工具。 我们的NWM修复本身使用NWM自己的训练规范;Act Rosetta让其他人对自己编码器进行同样的检查. 我们的贡献是: 1. 改变模型评价的动作相交错。 NWM的推出代码与参考框架、规范化相抵消和黄道包装的培训不同。 在不进行再培训的情况下,修复将RECON上的平均DreamSim误差从0.240降至0.139(42%)并去除或收缩两个替代模型的线索(第3条)。 2. 重复审计和有目击的归属。 ActRosetta查询将培训和评价编码器在受控路径上配对,只有当测试路径亲眼目睹时才命名一个不同的字段,只有在整个合同确定编码器的全套编码选择时才进行修复。 与ActionABI [2] 不同的是,它分享其原则,但从日志中回收合同,它诊断成对代码,确定一个补丁必须处理的相互作用选择(Sec. 4 – 5 )。 3. 将侦查、归属和修理分开的证据。 ActionFault Bench, 即我们动作编码器的双人基准, 其差异事先已经知道, 在最后的240-pair测试中,ActRosetta检测出所有91对不同的对子,在73个案例中准确恢复了它们的区别,并用输出转换(Sec. 6–7)来修复所有38对不同的对子.

blocks.en: Navigation world models. Later work builds on NWM [ 5 ] to improve rollout consistency [ 41 ] , use different visual representations [ 44 ] , generate interactive video [ 21 ] , plan with compact representations [ 24 ] and model long histories efficiently [ 14 ] . World-in-World places NWM inside closed-loop tasks, where its predictions guide an agent [ 43 ] . Such work can reuse NWM’s rollout code: in our audit, MWM’s executed rollout shares all three mismatches (Sec. 7 ).
blocks.zh: 导航世界模型. 后来的工作建立在NWM[5]的基础上,以提高推出的一致性[41],使用不同的视觉表现[44],生成互动视频[21],计划有紧凑的表述[24]并高效地模拟长历史[14]. World-in-World将NWM置于闭路任务中,它的预测引导着一种物剂 [43]. 此类工作可以重用NWM的推出代码:在我们的审计中,MWM执行的推出共享所有三种错配(sec.

blocks.en: Do world models follow actions? Several recent benchmarks test whether a model’s predictions respond correctly to the actions it is given (Table 1 ). MiraBench finds that visual quality is a poor guide to whether actions are followed [ 42 ] ; WorldEcho shows that models can fail on action sequences unlike those an expert would choose [ 8 ] ; WorldSimProbe states what a simulator’s outputs should show when actions are changed in a controlled way [ 9 ] ; WorldOracle compares predictions with paired executions of the same actions in the real world [ 10 ] ; and ActSWM finds that some models’ predictions become nearly identical under different action sequences [ 13 ] . These works judge what the model does with an action, which complements our check: a model can follow actions well and still be judged unfairly if its inputs are encoded differently.
blocks.zh: 世界模式是否遵循行动? 最近的一些基准检验一个模型的预测是否正确响应它给出的行动(表1)。 Mira Bench发现视觉质量对于是否遵循行动是一个差劲的指导[42]; World 回声显示模型在动作序列上可能失败,不同于专家选择的 [8];世界 SimProbe 表示模拟器的输出在动作以受控方式被改变时应当显示什么[9]; WorldOracle将预测与现实世界相同行动的对等处决进行比较[10];而ActSWM发现,一些模型的预测在不同的动作序列下变得几乎相同 [13]. 这些作品判断了这个模型用一个行动做什么,它补充了我们的检查:一个模型可以很好地跟踪行动,如果其输入码不同,仍然会受到不公正的判断.

blocks.en: Mismatched action inputs. Mind the Execution Gap [ 40 ] addresses mismatches in time, such as delay, packet loss and reordering when a frozen controller is executed asynchronously, and corrects them with an interface designed for each architecture; our mismatches are in the encoded values themselves. ActionABI [ 2 ] is closest in method. From logged state–action trajectories, it recovers the conventions an action encoder follows, keeps every candidate that fits the logs equally well, and converts actions only when the candidates agree, abstaining otherwise. ActRosetta follows the same principles but differs in evidence and goal: instead of logs from one system, it runs a model’s training and evaluation encoders on chosen test paths, explains where they disagree, and repairs the evaluation inputs. We do not claim that it recovers conventions better than ActionABI.
blocks.zh: 动作输入不匹配。 注意执行漏洞 [40] 及时解决不匹配问题, 如被冻结控制器同步执行时的延迟、 包丢失和重排, 用为每个架构设计的接口对其进行纠正; 我们的不匹配情况在编码值中本身 。 ActionABI [2] 在方法上最接近. 从记录的状态-行动轨迹来看,它恢复了公约所遵循的行动编码器,使每一个适合日志的候选者都保持同样的状态,并且只有在候选者同意的情况下,才能转换行动,否则就弃权。 Act Rosetta遵循同样的原则,但在证据和目标上却有所不同:它不使用一个系统的日志,而是在选定的测试路径上操作一个模型的培训和评价编码器,解释它们不同意的地方,并修复评价投入。 我们并不认为它比行动ABI更能恢复公约。

blocks.en: Evaluation details that change results. Experimental choices and run-to-run variability can change model comparisons [ 16 , 6 ] , ignoring statistical uncertainty can change conclusions [ 1 ] , and data leakage can inflate performance [ 22 ] . Simple baselines have shown that single-view reconstruction [ 37 ] and absolute pose regression [ 30 ] networks do something different from what their scores suggested. Closest to our setting, how images are resized and compressed changes the metrics used to evaluate GANs [ 28 ] , and rotation representation affects how well networks learn [ 46 ] ; we study the same kind of step for action inputs, including how yaw is represented.
blocks.zh: 评价详细说明了变化结果。 实验选择和跑到跑的可变性可以改变模型比较[16,6],而忽略统计不确定性可以改变结论[1],而数据渗出可以提高性能[22]. 简单的基线表明,单视重建[37]和绝对构成回归[30]网络所做的与他们的得分建议不同. 最接近于我们的设定,图像如何被调整大小并压缩 改变用来评价 GANs [28] 的度量, 和旋转表示影响网络如何学习 [46] ; 我们研究同样的动作输入步骤, 包括 yaw 如何代表 。

blocks.en: How we measure the effect. We compare predicted with recorded images using DreamSim [ 12 ] , a learned perceptual distance, and LPIPS [ 45 ] ; lower is better. Paired runs share clips and diffusion noise, so only the action inputs differ. RECON [ 32 ] (outdoor, in NWM’s training data) is the main dataset; SCAND [ 23 ] (also in training) and Go Stanford [ 17 ] (indoor, not in training) are additional tests. The main test uses NWM’s own 150 RECON rollout clips of 16 s (20 trajectories), its largest public checkpoint (XL), 250 diffusion steps as in NWM’s evaluation, seed 0, and 1 predicted frame per second (fps). A new cohort of 120 clips from 60 trajectories, recorded on 20 days and not examined before, tests all five public checkpoints [ 5 ] : sizes S, B, L and XL, and XL trained with additional Ego4D video (three seeds). Brackets give 95% trajectory-bootstrap confidence intervals [ 11 ] unless stated otherwise. A locked test had its protocol and analysis fixed before its results were seen (recorded locally, not publicly registered); exploratory work preceded the locked tests. Settings and further intervals are in App. M.

(b) Mean error over 1–16 s and its drop, with 95% trajectory-level intervals for the main test and 99% day-level intervals, corrected for five tests, for the five public checkpoints on the new cohort (120 clips, three seeds). blocks.zh: 图2 修复动作输入减少NWM的推出出错. (a) 主测试(150个RECON剪接,250个扩散步骤):每次预测时均出现DreamSim误差。 (b) 1至16 s的平均误差及其下降,主要测试的轨迹水平间隔为95%,5个测试的日平间隔为99%,新组群上的5个公共检查站(120个夹子、3个种子)的日平间隔为99%。 (c) 一次纠正一个不匹配现象(50个主测试片段,50个扩散步骤):只纠正抵消增加的误差;完全修理(两个固定)最低。

blocks.en: Repair reduces rollout error. In the main test, repair lowers mean DreamSim error, averaged over clips and prediction times 1–16 s, from 0.240 to 0.139, a reduction of 0.101 [0.076, 0.123] (42%), without retraining. At 16 s the reduction is 0.185 [0.151, 0.212] (51%; Figure 2 a,b). It holds across noise seeds and at 4 fps, and enabling NWM’s torch.compile , which our generation code omits, leaves the 16 s reduction almost unchanged. With NWM’s own evaluation script, our released-action LPIPS at 8 and 16 s is within 5% of NWM’s published values, and repaired-action LPIPS is 20% and 25% below them; as the released weights differ from the paper’s and we reran one sample rather than five, this is consistent with, but does not prove, the published results having used the released encoding (App. E). On the new cohort, all five checkpoints improve, four by more than 0.02, the smallest useful reduction we had set in advance. The Ego4D-trained checkpoint gains only 0.008, for reasons we cannot establish; with no Ego4D dataset class in the public code, its training encoding cannot be verified. These are variants of one model family, so this test alone does not establish generality.
blocks.zh: 修复可以减少推出错误 。 在主测试中,修理下行指DreamSim出错,平均超过剪辑和预测乘以1–16 s,从0.240到0.139,减少0.101 [0.076,0.123] (42%),不进行再培训. 16s的减少值为0.185 [0.151,0.212] (51%;图2a,b)。 并启用NWM的火炬。 编译,我们一代的代码省略, 16s的减少几乎不变。 用NWM自己的评价脚本,我们公布的LPIPS在8和16s的发行量在NWM公布值的5%以内,而修复的LPIPS则低于20%和25%;由于所公布的重量与论文不同,我们重新列出一个样本而不是五个样本,这与使用公布的编码(App. E)的公布结果是一致的,但并没有证明这一点。 在新的人群中,所有五个检查站都有所改善,四个检查站增加了0.02以上,这是我们事先确定的最小的有益减少。 由Ego4D训练的检查站只获得0.08分,原因我们无法确定;在公共代码中没有Ego4D数据集课,其训练编码无法核实. 这些是一模范家族的变体,因此单靠这个测试并不能确定通俗性.

blocks.en: Repair also improves motion. Lower image error need not mean better action following. In a locked test on 50 main-test clips (15 trajectories, 50 diffusion steps), each clip’s own actions and four other trajectories’ actions generate five 16 s futures; DreamSim picks the own-action future as closest to the recorded 16 s image for 15 of 50 clips with released actions and 40 of 50 with repaired actions (trajectory-averaged accuracy 0.50 [0.31, 0.69] and 0.86 [0.71, 0.97]; chance 0.20; LPIPS accuracy gain 0.43 [0.08, 0.73]). An inverse dynamics model, exploratory because it failed its locked forward-motion check (App. F), agrees: paths it estimates from repaired predictions are 1.39 m [0.89, 1.87] closer to the recorded path than those from released predictions (mean over 1–16 s and 150 clips), and released predictions are not measurably closer to the path their actions describe under the training encoding.
blocks.zh: 修理也改善了运动。 降低图像错误并不一定意味着遵循更好的动作 。 在对50个主测试片段(15个出轨,50个放行步骤)进行锁定测试时,每个片段自己的动作和其他4个出轨动作产生5个16个后期; DreamSim将50个片段中有15个有放行动作,40个有被修复动作(弹出-平均精度为0.50 [0.31,0.69]和0.86 [0.71,0.97];概率为0.20;LPIPS精度为0.43 [0.08,0.73]),选择自己动作的未来最接近所记录的16个图像. 反向动态模型,因其未成功锁定前向运动检查(App.F)而进行探索,同意:它从修复的预测中估计出的道路比所公布的预测(平均超过1至16 s和150 片段)更接近所记录的路径,而所公布的预测并不比培训编码中描述的道路更接近。

blocks.en: The encoding changes which checkpoint looks best. On the new cohort, the Ego4D-trained checkpoint moves from first to fourth after repair, and L becomes best (Figure 3 ). Four of the ten pairwise orderings reverse under both DreamSim and LPIPS, with day-level confidence intervals excluding zero and all four significant after Holm correction for ten comparisons; these placements hold when any one of the 20 recording days is left out. The analysis is exploratory because we chose it after seeing the means; the Ego4D checkpoint also differs in training data and length.
blocks.zh: 编码更改了检查点的外观 在新组别上,Ego4D训练的检查站在修理后从第一至第四,L成为最佳(图3)。 在DreamSim和LPIPS下,10个双向顺序中,有4个逆向排列,白天的置信间隔不包括0个,在Holm修正后所有4个重要位置进行10个比较;当20个录制日中的任何1个被忽略时,这些位置就维持住了。 分析是探索性的,因为我们在看到手段后选择了它;Ego4D检查站在培训数据和长度方面也有所不同.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Repair changes the order of NWM’s checkpoints. Each line connects one checkpoint’s mean DreamSim error with released actions (left) and repaired actions (right) on the new cohort of Figure 2 b; higher means lower error. Exploratory.
blocks.zh: 图3:修理改变了NWM检查站的秩序。 每行将一个检查站的平均 DreamSim 错误与释放的动作(左)相连接,并将修复的动作(右)连接在图2b的新组上;较高表示更低的错误. 探险。

blocks.en: The encoding affects comparisons between models. We then compare NWM with three alternative models: EgoWM [ 3 ] , which adds action conditioning to pretrained video diffusion models; RAE-NWM [ 44 ] , which predicts navigation futures in a dense visual representation space; and Vid2World [ 21 ] , which adapts video diffusion for interactive prediction. Each runs at its own settings on the same 4 s RECON clips (16 frames at 4 fps), under a comparison rule locked in advance; only NWM’s action inputs change (Figure 4 ). On 90 clips (19 trajectories, five seeds, one GPU type), EgoWM and RAE-NWM have lower DreamSim error than NWM with released actions, by 0.010 [0.002, 0.021] and 0.020 [0.013, 0.027]. After repair, NWM has lower error than EgoWM by 0.011 [0.005, 0.015], and RAE-NWM’s lead becomes − - 0.001 [ − - 0.007, +0.005]: no detectable difference, which does not establish equivalence. Under LPIPS, neither repaired difference excludes zero. Thirty of the 90 clips come from an earlier, smaller run; on the other 60, EgoWM has no clear lead even with released actions. Vid2World, run only in that earlier run (30 clips, one seed), keeps a reduced lead: 0.022 [0.017, 0.027], from 0.054 [0.038, 0.073]. EgoWM’s training code is not public, so its action interface is unverified, and the results describe our matched comparisons, not published scores.
blocks.zh: 编码影响模型之间的比较. 然后,我们将NWM与三个替代模型进行比较:EgoWM [3],它增加了动作条件,用于预先训练的视频传播模型;RAE-NWM [44],它预测了在密集的视觉表现空间中的导航未来;和Vid2World [21],它将视频传播用于交互预测. 每个在相同的 4 s RECON 剪辑上运行在自己的设置上( 16 帧 at 4 fps), 按照比较规则提前锁定; 只有 NWM 的动作输入变化( 图 4 ) 。 在90个剪辑上(19个出轨,5个种子,1个GPU型),EgoWM和RAE-NWM的DreamSim出错比有放出动作的NWM更低,比起0.010 [0.002,0.021]和0.020 [0.013,0.027]. 修复后,NWM的误差比EgoWM低0.011 [0.005,0.015],而RAE-NWM的铅会变成−-0.001 [−0.007,+0.005]:没有可被察觉到的差分,不能确定等同. 在LPIPS下,两个修复的差数都排除了零. 90个片段中有30个来自更早,更小的跑道;其他60个片段,EgoWM连被放出的行动都没有明确的线索. 维德2 出道的世界,只在之前出道的出道中跑出(出道了30个剪接,出道了一粒种子),保持了从0.054 [出道了,出道了0.038,出道了. EgoWM的训练代码并不公开,因此其动作界面未经验证,结果描述了我们相匹配的比较,而不是公布的分数.

Arrows go from NWM’s released actions (circles, “before repair”) to its repaired actions (squares, “after repair”). The axis is NWM’s DreamSim error minus the alternative model’s; left of zero favors NWM. Bars: 95% trajectory-level intervals. blocks.en: Mismatches interact, so partial corrections can hurt. Correcting one mismatch at a time instead of all three (50 main-test clips, 15 trajectories, 50 diffusion steps, seed 0; Figure 2 c; exploratory), we find that correcting only the normalization offset increases DreamSim error over released actions, by 0.048 [0.028, 0.062] at 1 fps and 0.110 [0.054, 0.139] at 4 fps. Correcting only the reference frame leaves 0.014 [0.005, 0.023] more error than full repair at 1 fps and is not measurably better than released actions at 4 fps ( − - 0.017 [ − - 0.039, +0.005]); correcting only yaw changes little. Conversely, adding only the frame mismatch to repaired actions raises error by 0.150 [0.107, 0.176], more than all three together, while adding only the offset mismatch does not measurably hurt (0.006 [ − - 0.002, +0.015]), so correcting only the offset leaves the most damaging mismatch in place. The whole encoding must therefore be checked before a patch is applied.
blocks.zh: 误差相互作用,因此部分更正可能伤害. 一次纠正一个错配,而不是全部三个错配(50个主测试片段,15个轨迹,50个扩散步骤,种子0;图2 c;探索性),我们发现,只纠正常态抵消增加了DreamSim对已放出动作的误差,比1个fps的0.048 [0.028,0.062]和4个fps的0.110 [0.054,0.139]. 仅更正参考框架留下了0.014 [0.005,0.023] 出错大于1英尺平方英尺的完全修复,且不比4英尺平方英尺的释放动作(−-0.017 [−-0.039,+0.005])好;仅更正yaw变化不大. 反之,只将帧错配加到修复动作上,则产生0.15 [0.107,0.176] 出错,超过全部三个加在一起,而只将相抵错配加到一起,不会造成可估量的伤害(0.006 [−-0.002,+0.015]),因此只纠正相抵错配会留下最有害的错配. 因此,在应用补丁之前必须检查整个编码。

blocks.en: Injected faults also hurt the alternative models. We also plant encoding errors ourselves, called injected faults ; mismatch stays reserved for differences in a model’s own code. In NWM, adding ± 2 ​ π \pm 2\pi to the yaw of every chunk after the first keeps the path but puts every yaw input far outside the training range, and raises error over repaired actions by 0.128 [0.106, 0.162] (exploratory), as much as released actions do, so a check must compare numerical inputs, not only the paths they describe. All 14 injected faults increase NWM’s error, from 0.006 (one-step lag) to 0.513 (reversed sign), and ActRosetta recovers the repaired actions exactly for all 14. To test whether this sensitivity extends beyond NWM, we inject frame, offset, combined (frame plus offset, as no clip has a natural yaw jump within 4 s) and 2 ​ π 2\pi faults into EgoWM and RAE-NWM on the 90 comparison clips, adapting the offset and 2 ​ π 2\pi faults to RAE-NWM’s convention; none is a bug in either model’s released code (App. T). Every fault hurts both models. The combined fault raises DreamSim error by 0.029 [0.024, 0.035] in EgoWM and 0.033 [0.026, 0.040] in RAE-NWM (seed 0, RTX 3090 Ti) and by 0.027 and 0.035 (seeds 1–2, A100 GPUs), all eight passing Holm correction within each GPU type; the path-preserving 2 ​ π 2\pi fault hurts most, by 0.180 and 0.092.
blocks.zh: 注射断层也伤害了替代模型. 我们自己也安装了编码错误,称为注入断层;不匹配保留在模型本身代码中的差异。 在 NWM 中,在第一个保存路径后将 ± 2 → \pm 2\pi 添加到每个块的 yaw 中,但将每个 yaw 输入置入到训练范围之外,并且像释放的动作一样在0.128 [0.106,0.162] (探索) 中引起对被修复动作的错误,所以检查必须比较数字输入,而不仅仅是它们描述的路径. 所有14个注入的断层都使NWM的误差从0.006(一步后差)增加到了0.513(倒转的标志),而Act Rosetta完全为所有14个恢复了被修复的动作. 为了检验这种敏感度是否超出NWM,我们注入了帧、相抵、相抵、相抵(帧加相抵,因为没有剪辑在4 s 以内有天然的yaw跳跃),在90个比较剪辑上有2 π 2\pi分入EgoWM和RAE-NWM, 将相抵和2 π 2\pi分入RAE-NWM的常规;在两个模型的放出代码中,没有一个是错误(App. T)。 每一个错误都会伤害两个模型. 结合断层使DreamSim错误在EgoWM中上升了0.029 [0.024,0.035],在RAE-NWM中上升了0.033 [0.026,0.040] (种子为0,RTX 3090 Ti),并上升了0.027和0.035 (种子为1–2,A100 GPU),每个GPU类型内全部有8个经过的Holm校正;路径保有2−2\pi断层伤害最重,达到0.180和0.092.

blocks.en: Where repair matters. The effect also depends on how a model represents actions and how strongly its predictions respond to them. Removing the normalization offset raises Vid2World’s DreamSim error by 0.059 [0.039, 0.083] (30 clips, one seed), whereas injected faults do not clearly hurt DrivingWorld [ 20 ] , a driving world model that takes actions as discrete tokens, and doubling its commanded distance even lowers its error by 0.037 [0.020, 0.059] (12 demonstration clips, one seed); lower prediction error alone therefore cannot establish that an encoding is correct. The action-responsiveness ratio divides the image change caused by substituting another clip’s actions by the change caused by a new random seed; above one, actions move predictions more than noise does. Encoding changes have clear effects where it is high, in NWM on RECON (2.25) and in Vid2World (2.54), and small ones where it is near one, in NWM on SCAND (1.10) and Go Stanford (0.90), where repair lowers error by only 0.006 and 0.005, and in DrivingWorld (0.995); injected faults hurt EgoWM (2.41) and RAE-NWM (1.84). This pattern is descriptive: the tests differ in clips, frame rates and horizons. Better images need not mean better decisions: in Habitat [ 31 ] with Matterport3D [ 7 ] scenes, repair does not measurably improve command following (40 cases) or image-goal decisions (20 cases, two runs; App. Q), so we make no claim of improved control. NWM’s own planning code builds actions by a separate route that matches training at default settings, so these mismatches do not reach its planning results.
blocks.zh: 修行之所关. 其影响还取决于一个模型如何代表行动,以及其预测如何有力地响应这些行动。 取消常态偏移使Vid2World的DreamSim出错0.059 [0.039, 0.083] (30个弹夹, 1个种子), 而注入的断层并没有明显地伤害到驱动世界[20], 驱动世界模型将动作作为离散的符号, 并且将其指令距离翻倍甚至降低了0.037 [0.020, 0.059] (12个演示弹夹, 1个种子) ; 因此,仅靠较低的预测误差无法确定编码是否正确。 动作能反应比将由由由新随机种子所引发的改变来取而代之的又一片段动作所引发的图像变化相分;在一上,动作能移动的预测比噪音能多. 编码变化在高处有明显影响,在RECON(2.25)和Vid2World(2.54),在接近一处的编码变化有明显影响,在SCAND(1.10)和Go Stanford(0.90)的编码变化中,修理误差只有0.006和0.005;在驾驶世界(0.995);注射断层会伤害EgoWM(2.41)和RAE-NWM(1.84)。 这种模式是描述性的:测试在剪辑,帧率和地平线上有所不同. 更好的图像并不一定意味着更好的决定:在人居[31],用Matterport3D[7]的场景,修复并不能在40个案例之后或图像目标决定(20个案例,两起运行;App.Q)之后明显改善指挥,所以我们没有提出改进控制的要求。 NWM自己的规划代码通过一个单独的路径构建动作,在默认设置中匹配训练,因此这些不匹配没有达到规划结果.

blocks.en: What can be recovered from queries. We call an encoder on test paths, called probes , and observe its outputs without reading its code. Different contracts may produce exactly the same outputs, so our target is a behavioural class : all contracts that agree on every allowed input. The allowed inputs form the admissible domain 𝒟 \mathcal{D} : by default, all planar pose sequences with chunk sizes s ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 } s\in\{1,2,4\} , including turns that cross the angle-wrap boundary within a chunk; the implementation compares contracts on 𝒟 \mathcal{D} using a fixed finite set of long paths. Each class is reported by its canonical member, the one with the fewest non-default discrete choices, as a convention, not evidence about the source code. A field is unexcited when the probes do not vary the motion needed to reveal it (a path with no rotation may not distinguish heading conventions), and an encoder is out of family when no contract in the family reproduces its outputs within tolerance. Standing still reveals an offset, translations reveal axis mappings, and turns reveal reference-frame and yaw conventions. Proposition 1 formalizes this for a restricted core family , without timing shifts or saturation.

blocks.en: ActRosetta, our tool, calls a training and an evaluation encoder on the same probes and answers at two levels. The first, the family-free check , is differential testing, which we do not claim as new: it reports whether their outputs differ on a fixed path set, with a path where they do (Algorithm 1 , lines 2 and 9); Sec. 7 compares it with random fuzzing. The second level, which recovers both contracts, is what ActRosetta adds to detection: it names the fields a patch must change, since mismatches interact, and repairs only when the whole contract is determined.
blocks.zh: Act Rosetta,我们的工具,在两个层次上要求在同一探测器和答案上进行培训和评估编码。 第一,无家庭检查,是差别测试,我们不声称这是新的测试:它报告他们的输出在固定路径集上是否有差异,并有他们这样做的路径(算法1, 第2行和第9行);sec. 7将其与随机模糊相比较. 收回两个合同的第二层是Act Rosetta为检测所添加的内容:它将一个补丁命名为必须改变的字段,因为不匹配是相互作用的,只有在确定整个合同时才进行修理.

blocks.en: Witness-backed naming. Two contracts can differ in a field that does not explain their difference. blocks.en: ActionFaultBench, our benchmark, consists of training–evaluation encoder pairs with known differences; it scores detection, naming, refusal and repair separately.

blocks.en: Categories. Scoring targets behaviour, not source edits. Clean pairs behave the same through independent code and no-op pairs change the source but not the behaviour; reporting a difference on either is a false alarm . Identifiable and non-invertible pairs, together the differing pairs , differ in family fields, with or without a way back from evaluation outputs; a differing pair is an exact recovery when the named fields are exactly the true differences. Ambiguous pairs restrict the paths so that some differences cannot be revealed, and naming a field outside the true differences is an error. Out-of-family pairs must be refused, and noisy pairs declare noisy poses.

blocks.en: Sealed runs. A sealed run tests frozen code on a sealed set of pairs its developers have not seen. Before each run we fixed the categories and targets ( ≥ \geq 95% exact recovery, no wrong field named, ≥ \geq 95% refusal, floating-point repair) and froze the code by hash; a separate automated agent, without access to the method code or earlier sets, then wrote the pairs and labels in new interface families , groups of pairs built around one encoder convention, from a description of our contract family (complete from the third run on). The sets thus test our family against itself, and refusal only on deliberate departures from it; no person outside the method team prepared or checked any set. Predictions were stored once before labels were opened. Runs 1–3 were development challenges, each followed by fixes, and stand as scored; the final run is the only test of witness-backed naming (details in App. L). Pairs in one interface family are not independent, so we give counts, not binomial intervals. Faults injected into the encoders of NWM (Sec. 3 ), RAE-NWM [ 44 ] , Vid2World [ 21 ] and the ViNT, GNM and NoMaD navigation policies [ 34 , 33 , 36 ] were used in development, so results on them are optimistic. Baseline settings and the real-code pairs are in App. O.

blocks.en: Rollout evaluation assumes that actions are encoded as in training. NWM’s released rollout code breaks it through three interacting mismatches; repairing them, with unchanged weights, lowers NWM’s mean DreamSim error on RECON by 42% and changes how its checkpoints (exploratory) and alternative models compare. ActRosetta turns this audit into a check others can run on their own encoders. Before reporting rollout error, compare training and evaluation action encoders on paths longer than one chunk; if they differ, use the training code or identify every differing field before patching. Code and ActionFaultBench will be released.
blocks.zh: 推出评价假设行动与培训相同。 NWM发布的推出代码打破了三种相互作用的错配;用不变的权重对其进行修复,将NWM在RECON上的平均DreamSim误差降低42 %并改变其检查站(探索)和替代模型的对比方式. Act Rosetta将这次审计变成一次检查,其他人可以自行运行编码器. 在报告推出错误之前,在超过一个块的路径上比较培训和评价行动编码器;如果它们不同,在补丁前使用培训代码或识别每个不同的领域。 代码和ActionFault Bench将发布.

blocks.en: Limitations. Model evidence is concentrated on NWM and RECON. Repair changes error little where predictions respond weakly to actions (NWM on SCAND and Go Stanford), fault tests on alternative models use only 4 s clips, and repair did not measurably improve decisions in Habitat, so we claim nothing about control. ActRosetta names and repairs only within a finite planar family. Exact recovery missed our 95% target in every sealed run (73 of 91 in the final one), and in 40 new repositories naming refused all five mismatches that the family-free check found, with a second-level verdict on 14 of 28. Automated agents wrote the sealed sets from our family’s description, so they test the family against itself. Our diagnosis rests on NWM’s code at the audited commit; later versions may differ.

blocks.en: The family-free check on the final sealed set (post hoc). To see what detection alone achieves on held-out pairs, we ran ActRosetta’s family-free check by itself on all 240 pairs of the final sealed set, after the set had been opened. It is the differential test of the refusal branch of Algorithm 1 (line 2): both encoders are called on a fixed set of 24 paths (the 18 default probes, 4 random hold-out paths and 2 long paths of 48 transitions each, at the pair’s chunk sizes; this set is separate from the range and hold-out paths that recovery uses in Sec. 5), and any relative output difference above 10 − 6 10^{-6} , change of output shape or exception counts as a difference. Where a pair restricts the allowed paths, only those paths are used. The check flagged none of the 53 clean and no-op pairs, all 91 differing pairs (as did ActRosetta with naming; Table 3) and all 48 out-of-family pairs. Ambiguous pairs have no detection label; 10 of the 34 differ on their restricted paths. All 14 noisy pairs differ, as expected when logged poses are noisy, so the check does not apply to them. It used a median of 976 transitions per pair, counted as ActRosetta’s recovery counts them, against 400 for ActRosetta and 280 for random fuzzing. Because the set had been opened, this is not a held-out number; the frozen code’s hashes were unchanged before and after the run. On this set, the family-free check thus adds no detection beyond ActRosetta’s own.

blocks.en: Injected faults. We injected 14 faults, each at one setting, into NWM’s repaired actions on 50 main-test clips (15 trajectories, 1 fps, 16 s, 50 diffusion steps, seed 0). Every fault raised mean DreamSim error, with every 95% interval above zero, from +0.0062 for a one-step lag to +0.5125 for a reversed sign (Figure S2 b). The stride fault, under which each chunk reads twice as many raw time steps, needs 32 s of poses; on the 25 clips that have them, which span only four trajectories, it raises error by +0.0835 [+0.0583, +0.1238]. Each fault was run at one parameter setting, so the ordering in Figure S2 b need not hold at other magnitudes.
blocks.zh: 被注射出错. 我们为NWM在50个主测试片段(15个轨迹、1英尺、16秒、50个扩散步骤、0个种子)上的修复动作注入了14个断层。 每升出一次故障,均指DreamSim出错,每95%的间隔都高于0,从一步后差的+0.062到倒转的后差的+0.5125(图S2b). 每个块读取了两倍于生时间步骤的快板断层,需要32 s的姿势;在只有它们并跨越四个轨迹的25个相片上,它会以+0.0835 [+0.0583,+0.1238]引起出错. 每个断层在一个参数设置中运行,因此图S2b中的顺序不需要在其它等分上被维持.

blocks.en: Repair of the injected faults. For all 14 faults on all 50 clips, ActRosetta’s repaired actions equal the correct actions as float32 values: 11 faults were repaired by the adapter from evaluation outputs, and 3 (lag, stride and last-step aggregation, which are not invertible) from poses. Because NWM’s generation is deterministic, equal actions give the same rollout. We confirmed this by generating 3 clips for each of 3 repaired faults, which showed zero pixel difference.
blocks.zh: 修复被注射的断层. ActRosetta的修复动作与浮点32的数值相同:适配器从评价产出中修补了11个故障,从平面上修补了3个(lag, stread and last-step community,这些并非不可逆)。 因为NWM的一代是决定性的,所以平等行动可以同样推出。 我们通过生成3个修复断层的3个片段证实了这一点,这些断层显示零像素差异.

blocks.en: Correcting one mismatch at a time at 4 fps. Section 3 compares frame-only correction with full repair at 1 fps. At 4 fps (the same 50 clips, 64 frames over 16 s, 50 diffusion steps, seed 0), correcting only the reference frame leaves DreamSim error 0.058 [0.036, 0.093] above full repair. Correcting only yaw changes little, even though the released yaw mismatch produces jumps of a full turn in 63 of the 150 main-test clips; Sec. S discusses why.
blocks.zh: 在 4 fps 一次纠正一个错配 。 第3节将仅帧校正与全修相提并论 1 fps. 在4 fps(同为50个夹片,64个帧相超16 s,50个扩散步骤,种子0)中,只更正了参考框后,将DreamSim出错0.058 [0.036,0.093]完全修复. 校正只有 yaw 变化很小, 尽管释放的 yaw 不匹配 产生跳跃 完全转动 在 150 主测试剪辑中的 63; Sec. S讨论为什么。

blocks.en: Why the benefit of repair varies across datasets. Repair helps far less outside RECON. On Go Stanford, which NWM was not trained on, mean DreamSim error moves from 0.505 to 0.500, a reduction of 0.005 [0.001, 0.010] (150 clips, 79 trajectories, 50 diffusion steps, seed 0), although the path that the released actions command ends a mean 3.76 m [3.36, 4.17] from the recorded endpoint at 16 s. SCAND, which is in NWM’s training data, is similar: 0.319 to 0.313, a reduction of 0.006 [0.001, 0.014] (150 clips, 13 trajectories, 25 diffusion steps, seed 0).
blocks.zh: 修复的好处为何因数据集而异. 修理在RECON之外帮助得远远不够. 在Go Stanford上,NWM没有受过训练,意思是DreamSim错误从0.505移到0.500,减少0.005 [0.001,0.010](150个剪辑,79个轨迹,50个扩散步骤,种子0),不过释放的动作指令从记录的16 s. SCAND的收尾点上结束一个3.76 m [3.36, 4.17] 的路径类似:0.319到0.313,减少0.006 [0.001,0.014] (150个剪辑,13个轨迹,25个扩散步骤,种子0).

blocks.en: The action-responsiveness ratio suggests why (Figure S2 a). For each clip, E E is the DreamSim distance between the predictions made from the clip’s own actions and from another trajectory’s actions of matched path length, at the same noise seed, and F F is the distance between the predictions made from the clip’s own actions under two different seeds; R = E ¯ / F ¯ R=\bar{E}/\bar{F} , the ratio of their means over clips and seeds. We fixed its reading before running: a lower confidence bound above 1.5 means that images change with actions beyond noise, an upper bound below 1.25 means that the action effect is indistinguishable from or below noise, and anything else is inconclusive. On RECON, R R is 2.25 [2.03, 2.63]; on SCAND, 1.10 [0.95, 1.24]; and on Go Stanford, 0.90 [0.86, 0.95]. Where images barely respond to actions, correcting the actions has little room to help, so a small effect of repair is no evidence that a mismatch is harmless.
blocks.zh: 行动响应率说明原因(图S2a)。 对于每个片段,E是从片段自身动作和从另一轨迹行走的相匹配路径长度的预测之间的 DreamSim相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距 我们在运行前固定了它的读取:1.5上方的下置置信度意味着图像会随着超出噪音的动作而改变,1.25下方的上置信度意味着动作效果与噪音相去不远或低于噪音,其他任何事物都是没有定论的. 在RECON上,R为2.25 [2.03, 2.63];在SCAND上,1.10 [0.95, 1.24];在去斯坦福上,0.90 [0.86, 0.95]. 在图像几乎无法对动作作出反应的地方,纠正动作几乎没有帮助的余地,所以小的修复效果并不能证明不匹配是无害的.

blocks.en: Responsiveness by checkpoint. To test whether responsiveness explains why the Ego4D-trained checkpoint gains least from repair on the new cohort (Sec. 3), we computed R R for all five checkpoints on the same 50 RECON clips (14 trajectories, seeds 0–2, 50 diffusion steps, 95% trajectory intervals). It is 2.25 [2.03, 2.63] for XL, 2.36 [2.12, 2.72] for L, 1.81 [1.65, 2.07] for B, 1.37 [1.24, 1.56] for S and 1.40 [1.28, 1.60] for XL trained with Ego4D. Their mean DreamSim reductions from repair on the new cohort are 0.076, 0.100, 0.093, 0.080 and 0.0076. S and the Ego4D checkpoint respond alike to actions but gain very differently, so responsiveness does not explain the Ego4D checkpoint’s small gain. What separates these two checkpoints from the others is that a new seed changes their frames more ( F ¯ \bar{F} of 0.17–0.18, against 0.10–0.13), not that substituted actions change them less. XL’s ratio was computed on another machine with the same GPU model. The other four checkpoints share one public training dataset class, so one contract check covers them. No public code builds the Ego4D checkpoint’s action-labelled training data, and its checkpoint file keeps no training settings, so its contract cannot be checked.

blocks.zh: 附录 C Vid2World:注射断层,修复和反应能力

blocks.en: Figure S3 : Injected faults and their repair in Vid2World on RECON. (a) Increase in mean DreamSim error over 16 predicted frames (4 s at 4 fps) relative to correct actions, built by Vid2World’s own dataset code: 30 clips, 19 trajectories, one seed, 50 diffusion steps; bars are 95% trajectory-level confidence intervals. (b) DreamSim distance from the predictions made with correct actions, for faulted and repaired actions (two clips per fault; log scale). Vid2World is not bit-deterministic, so the shaded band shows the distance between two runs with identical input and seed. Repaired predictions differ from the correct ones about as much as such a repeated run does, and far less than faulted ones.
blocks.zh: 图S3:在RECON上的Vid2World被注射断层及其修复. (a) 相对于正确行动,比16个预测框架(4 s at 4 fps)的平均DreamSim误差增加,由Vid2World自己的数据集代码构建:30个剪辑、19个轨迹、1个种子、50个传播步骤;栏杆为95%的轨迹-水平置信间隔。 (b) DreamSim与用正确动作作出的预测相去甚远,用于断层和被修复的动作(每断层两片;日志比例)。 维德2 世界不是用位定型的,因此被遮蔽的波段显示了两个有相同输入和种子的跑道之间的距离. 修复后的预测与正确的预测大相径庭。

blocks.en: Vid2World [ 21 ] uses the same action normalization as NWM but is a separately trained video model, so it tests whether NWM’s encoding choices matter in a second predictor (Sec. 3, “Where repair matters”). We use its RECON checkpoint, with its own dataset code building the correct actions, on 30 RECON clips from 19 trajectories: one seed (equal to the clip index), 50 diffusion steps with DDIM sampling [ 35 ] and classifier-free guidance 2.5, and 16 predicted frames at 4 fps (4 s). The first 10 clips were extended by 20 clips from new trajectories, chosen by a rule fixed before generation but not at random; the extension took 13.70 GPU hours on one RTX 3090 Ti, in one process. Intervals are 95% trajectory-cluster bootstrap intervals, without correction for multiple comparisons.
blocks.zh: Vid2World [21] 使用与NWM相同的动作常态化,但是一个经过单独训练的视频模型,因此它测试了NWM编码选择在第二个预测器中是否重要(第3节,"哪里修理很重要"). 我们使用其RECON检查点,用自己的数据集代码构建正确的动作,在19个轨迹的30个RECON剪接点上:一个种子(等于剪接指数),用DDIM取样的50个扩散步骤[35],并用4个英尺(4秒)进行无分级指导2.5和16个预测帧. 最初的10个剪辑被从新轨迹上延长了20个剪辑,由一代前固定的规则所选择,但并不是随机的;扩展在一个过程中需要1个RTX 3090 Ti上的13.70 GPU小时. 间距为95%的轨迹-星团的靴子间隔,不更正多个比较.

blocks.en: Injected faults. Removing the normalization offset raised DreamSim error by 0.059 [0.039, 0.083], from 0.085 with correct actions, and it raised error on all 30 clips. Supplying yaw in degrees instead of radians raised error by 0.693 [0.675, 0.708]; in the clips we inspected, the predictions became texture rather than scenes, so this measures a broken model, not a realistic degradation. Two faults had small effects: a reference frame fixed at the start heading (+0.005 [ − - 0.002, +0.012]) and a one-step lag (+0.001 [ − - 0.003, +0.005]). Their LPIPS intervals exclude zero but their DreamSim intervals do not, and none of the eight intervals (four faults, two metrics) is corrected for multiple comparisons, so we read these two effects as weak evidence.
blocks.zh: 被注射出错. 取消正常化抵消使DreamSim错误从0.085升至0.059 [0.039,0.083],并有正确的动作,它使所有30个剪辑都出现了错误. 以等分而不是弧度提供yaw使误差上升了0.693 [0.675,0.708];在我们所检查的片段中,预测变成了纹理而不是场景,因此这测量了一个被破坏的模型,而不是现实的降解. 两个断层产生了小的影响:一个在起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起站起 他们的LPIPS间隔排除了0,但是他们的DreamSim间隔没有,8个间隔(4个出错,2个度量)中没有一个被更正为多个比较,所以我们把这两个效果读作弱证据.

blocks.en: Repair. ActRosetta diagnosed all four faults correctly (offset, frame, yaw units and lag). Its repaired tensors match the correct ones to at most 4.5 × 10 − 8 4.5\times 10^{-8} ; only the lag, which is not invertible and was repaired from poses, is bit-identical on every clip. Because Vid2World is not bit-deterministic, two runs with identical input and seed give slightly different frames. After finding this, we compared regenerated frames with a repeated run of the correct input, on 2 clips per fault (Figure S3 b). On the two clips, repaired predictions were at DreamSim 0.0002–0.0005 and 0.004–0.005 from the correct ones, against 0.0004 and 0.017 for a repeated run with the same input, and 0.037–0.82 for faulted predictions. Over 10 clips, repeated runs with the same input changed the error to ground truth by a mean of 0.0007 DreamSim and 0.0009 LPIPS, and all 10 showed some non-determinism.
blocks.zh: 修补. Act Rosetta正确诊断出所有四个断层(错位,帧,yaw单位和滞后). 其修复的收发机与正确的收发机最多相匹配4.5×10-8 4.5\times 10×8};只有时差,即并非不可逆并用姿势来修复的收发机,在每个收发机片段上都是比特-同. 由于Vid2World不是位定型,两个运行时输入相同,种子给出的帧略有不同. 找到后,我们将再生成的帧与一次对正确的输入的重复运行相比较,每个断层有2个片段(图S3b). 在两个剪辑上,修复的预测在DreamSim 0.0002–0.0005和正确预测的0.004–0.005之间,对相同输入的重复运行的0.0004和0.017,对错误预测的0.037–0.82。 超过10个片段,重复使用相同的输入来运行,以0.0007 DreamSim和0.0009 LPIPS的平均值来将错误改变为地面真理,所有10个都表现出了一些非决定性.

blocks.en: Action responsiveness. With E E , F F and R R defined as in Sec. B , we measured Vid2World’s responsiveness on 12 of the 30 clips, chosen by a seeded rule (9 trajectories), with seeds 0–2 at the settings above; donors were path-length-matched clips from other trajectories. Substituting a donor’s actions changed the frames 2.54 [2.16, 3.02] times as much as a new seed did by DreamSim ( E ¯ = 0.1229 \bar{E}=0.1229 , F ¯ = 0.0484 \bar{F}=0.0484 ; E ¯ − F ¯ = + 0.0745 \bar{E}-\bar{F}=+0.0745 [+0.0564, +0.0958]; E > F E>F on all 12 clips), and 1.84 [1.70, 1.98] times as much by LPIPS (95% trajectory-cluster bootstrap). By the reading fixed in advance, Vid2World’s images change with actions beyond noise. The seed-0 predictions with correct actions were reused from a run on another machine; F ¯ \bar{F} is 0.0490 with them and 0.0473 without. NWM’s ratio on RECON, 2.25 [2.03, 2.63] (Sec. B ), comes from other clips at 1 fps over 16 s, so the two ratios are compared only descriptively. Vid2World’s ratio rests on 12 clips from 9 trajectories, a 4 s horizon, one checkpoint and RECON only.

blocks.en: Injected faults. We injected four faults into its 12 moving demonstration clips, which its authors chose, and generated 40 frames (8 s at 5 Hz) with one seed; intervals are 95% bootstrap intervals over clips. We fixed this design after a two-clip smoke test in which one fault had already lowered error. ActRosetta named all four faults on the continuous actions before tokenization, but it refuses the token stage as outside its family and abstains from repair at the model’s one chunk size, so repair used DrivingWorld’s own encoder on the poses. Here, injected faults did not clearly hurt. Supplying yaw in radians instead of degrees, a one-step lag and a world reference frame changed DreamSim error by − - 0.000 [ − - 0.005, +0.004], +0.002 [ − - 0.001, +0.005] and − - 0.001 [ − - 0.003, +0.003], and they changed the frames no more than a new seed does. Doubling the forward distance lowered error by 0.037 [0.020, 0.059], on 11 of 12 clips. On 2 clips, the model’s own forward prediction from real context frames was 0.54–0.86 of the recorded value. Either the model under-advances, or the demonstration actions differ in scale from its training actions; with no public training script, we could not check which. This run therefore does not show that injected faults degrade evaluation in this format, and it shows that lower image error cannot replace an interface check.

blocks.en: Follow-up on responsiveness and scale. After seeing that result, we fixed a follow-up design in advance on the same 12 clips and 40 frames, with one seed for the substituted actions, one seed pair for noise, and a bootstrap over clips (with 12 clips, the intervals are approximate). Another clip’s length-matched actions changed the frames by DreamSim 0.0542, against 0.0545 for a new seed: R = 0.995 R=0.995 [0.768, 1.224]. By the reading fixed in advance (Sec. B ), the action effect is indistinguishable from noise; LPIPS gives 1.137 [0.862, 1.406], which is inconclusive. Error fell steadily as the commanded distance grew: 0.149, 0.133, 0.107 and 0.096 at 0.5, 1, 1.5 and 2 times the given distance. Relative to the given actions, half the distance raised error by 0.016 [0.008, 0.026], and double the distance lowered it by 0.037 [0.020, 0.059]. Progress along the recorded clip, fitted from DreamSim embeddings, rose from 0.44 [0.37, 0.52] with the given actions to 0.89 [0.74, 1.00] at double distance, while sharpness fell slightly. Lower error thus came with frames that keep pace with the recorded clip, not with sharper frames. This fits demonstration actions that differ in scale from training, or a model that under-advances; without a training script, we cannot tell which. The tokens and the doubled-distance result reproduced the earlier run on all 12 clips, with identical frames on 11.

blocks.en: Section 3 states that, with NWM’s own evaluation script, our released-action LPIPS is close to NWM’s published values. This section gives the full comparison (Table S1 ), the tests we set for it in advance, and two details of the released code that it exposed. NWM publishes LPIPS and FID for RECON rollouts, not DreamSim, so the comparison uses those two metrics.
blocks.zh: 第3节指出,随着NWM自己的评价脚本,我们发布的LPIPS接近NWM公布的数值. 本节给出了完整的比较(表S1),我们事先为其设定的测试,以及它所暴露的已发布代码的两个细节. NWM出版的LPIPS和FID用于RECON推出,而不是DreamSim,因此比较使用这两个度量.

blocks.en: How we ran NWM’s script. NWM’s released weights were retrained after face blurring, as its maintainer states [ 27 ] , so they are not the paper’s checkpoint. NWM’s inference script does not run as released, because an import is commented out. We therefore ran the unedited file through a small runner that adds only that import, a fix for batch size one, a per-clip seed and the data path. The repaired arm changes only the action deltas.
blocks.zh: 我们如何运行 NWM的剧本。 NWM的放出重量在脸部模糊后被重新训练, NWM 的推论脚本并没有像发布的那样运行, 因为一个导入被评论出来 。 因此,我们通过一个小跑道运行未经编辑的文件,该跑道只添加了该导入,为批量尺寸一的固定,每个剪接种子和数据路径. 修复的手臂只改变动作三角洲.

blocks.en: Tests set in advance. The first test asked whether our released-action values lie within three published standard deviations; they do not, except for LPIPS at 4 s and FID at 16 s, so this is not a reproduction within the paper’s sampling noise. The second test allowed for the retrained checkpoint, with a margin of 10% for LPIPS and 20% for FID; every horizon passes, the closest being FID at 8 s, at +19.2%. Released and repaired actions give identical results at 1 s, where the mismatches cannot act. On the time-shift evaluation, which predicts one frame a fixed time ahead in a single call and so cannot be reached by the mismatches, our results with the released checkpoint (500 clips) match numbers that another user posted publicly for it [ 27 ] , within limits we set in advance; for instance, LPIPS at 4 s is 0.309 against 0.310. At 8 and 16 s, our released-action LPIPS is within 5% of the published values, and repaired-action LPIPS is 20% and 25% below them (Sec. 3). We read this as an anchor with an offset that the checkpoint difference could explain but that we cannot test: it is consistent with, but does not prove, the published results having used the released encoding. We ran neither the 4 fps setting nor the other four published samples.
blocks.zh: 提前进行测试 第一项测试询问我们释放的活性值是否在三个公布的标准偏差之内;除了4 s 的LPIPS和16 s 的FID之外,它们没有,因此这不是纸上取样噪声的复制. 第二次测试允许重新训练检查站,LPIPS的差值为10%,FID为20%;每个地平线通过,最接近的FID为8s,为+19.2%. 释放和修复的动作在1 s 产生相同的结果,其中不匹配者无法行动. 在时间变化的评价中,我们预测在一次通话中提前一个固定时间,因此不匹配无法达到,因此,我们与公布的检查站(500个剪辑)的结果与另一个用户为它公开公布的数字相匹配[27],在我们事先设定的限度内;例如,LPIPS 4 s是0.309,对0.310。 8和16秒时,我们发布的LPIPS在已公布值的5%以内,而被修复的LPIPS则在20%和25%以下(第3节)。 我们读到这个是锚,其中有一个抵消点,检查站的差异可以解释,但我们不能测试:它符合但不能证明使用已发布的编码结果。 我们既不运行4英尺的设定,也不运行其他4个公布的样本.

blocks.en: Two details of the released code. First, the released script calls torch.compile , which changes rollouts. On the same seed, released 16 s error is lower with compile on, by 0.0072 [0.0024, 0.0128] LPIPS and 0.0136 [0.0037, 0.0261] DreamSim (150 clips); other horizons move by less than 0.001. Repaired error moves by at most 0.002 at any horizon (74 clips from 17 trajectories; the run stopped at our compute cap). The main paper’s 0.240 is a compile-off number. On the 22 clip–arm pairs we checked, frames generated with compile off matched across two machines to within one intensity level. Second, the evaluation script averages batch means: with 150 clips in batches of 64, its last batch of 22 clips counts as much as a full batch. This moves means by up to 0.011 and makes them depend on the order in which files are listed, so we report plain clip means everywhere else.
blocks.zh: 发布代码的两个细节. 首先,发行的剧本叫"火炬.compile"(火炬. 在同一个种子上,放出16 s出错随着编译在0.0072 [0.0024,0.0128] LPIPS和0.0136 [0.0037,0.0261] DreamSim (150个片段;其他地平线移动小于0.001. 修复错误在任意地平线上移动最多为0.002个(从17个轨迹的74个剪接;运行在我们的计算盖上停止了). 主纸的0.240是一个编译出的数字. 我们检查了22个相接相机, 二,评价剧本平均批次是指: 有150个片段分批64个片段,其上一批22个片段算得上一整批. 这个动作意味着最多0.011,并使它们取决于文件的排列顺序,所以我们报告平板剪辑意味着其他任何地方.

blocks.en: Lower image error need not mean that predictions follow the commanded motion. Section 3 reports three tests of whether they do; this section gives their settings and full results. Here the true path is the recorded path, and the misread path is the path that the released actions describe when they are decoded with the training contract, that is, the motion a model that reads its inputs as in training would be asked to imagine. All three tests were locked before any result existed. The inverse dynamics model failed its locked forward-motion check, so its results are exploratory; the other two tests do not depend on it. Intervals are 95% bootstrap intervals over trajectories (10,000 resamples).
blocks.zh: 下图像出错并不一定意味着预测会遵循所指令的运动. 第3节报告了对是否这样做的三项测试;本节介绍了它们的设置和全部结果。 这里真正的路径是被录制的路径,错误读取路径是释放出的行动在与训练合同解码时所描述的路径,即运动一个读取其投入的模型,就像训练中被要求想象的那样. 所有三项测试都锁定在任何结果存在之前。 反向动力学模型未能实现其锁定前向运动检查,因此其结果是探索性的;另外两个测试并不依赖于它. 间距为轨迹上95%的靴子夹间隔(10,000个复标).

blocks.en: Counterfactual retrieval. For the first 50 main-test clips (15 trajectories), we chose four other clips from poses alone: from other trajectories, with 16 s endpoints at least 2 m from the true one. Each clip’s own actions and the four other clips’ actions generated five 16 s futures per arm (500 rollouts in all; 50 diffusion steps, 1 fps, seed equal to the clip index), and we asked whether the future generated from the clip’s own actions is the one closest to the recorded 16 s frame (chance 0.20). By DreamSim, it was closest for 15 of 50 clips with released actions and 40 of 50 with repaired actions; averaged over trajectories, the accuracies are 0.50 [0.31, 0.69] and 0.86 [0.71, 0.97], a gain of +0.36 [+0.10, +0.59]. By LPIPS, the counts are 10 and 38 of 50 and the accuracies 0.32 [0.14, 0.52] and 0.75 [0.58, 0.90], a gain of +0.43 [+0.08, +0.73]. The DreamSim margin of the mean other clip over the clip’s own actions was 0.061 [0.005, 0.118] with released actions and 0.162 [0.132, 0.191] with repaired actions. With repaired actions, the commanded motion is therefore visible in the 16 s image.

blocks.en: Inverse dynamics. An inverse dynamics model (a ResNet-34 [ 15 ] that predicts the motion between two frames) was trained on 1,470 RECON trajectories from 6 recording dates and validated on all trajectories of a seventh date. Its training data share no trajectory with any test list and no date with the main test. Before use, it had to pass three checks on real frames: yaw, forward motion and a path test. It passed the yaw and path checks, but in all three allowed attempts it failed the forward-motion check, which required the 95% interval of the slope of estimated on true forward motion to lie inside [0.8, 1.2] (best 0.693 [0.582, 0.804]). Forward motion over one chunk barely varies (mean 0.996 m, SD 0.128 m), which may make that check unreachable; we noticed this only after the failures.
blocks.zh: 反向动态. 一个逆向动态模型(一个预测两帧间运动的ResNet-34 [15])接受了从6个录相日期开始的1,470个RECON轨迹的培训,并在第7个日期的所有轨迹上进行了验证. 其培训数据没有与任何试验清单共享轨道,也没有与主要试验的日期共享。 在使用前,它必须通过对真实框架的三次检查:yaw,前进运动和路径测试. 它通过了“yaw”和“路径检查”,但在所有三次检查中,它都允许“前向”检查失败,这要求真实前向运动估计坡度的95%间隔位于其中[0.8、1.2](最佳0.693 [0.582、0.804])。 一个块的前进运动几乎没有变化(平均0.996米,SD0.128米),这可能使检查无法到达;我们只是在失败后才注意到这一点。

blocks.en: We applied the model to the main-test rollouts (150 clips, 20 trajectories, 250 diffusion steps, seed 0). Distances below are mean position errors over 1–16 s between the estimated path and a reference path, without alignment. On real frames of the test clips, the estimated path is 1.49 m [1.13, 1.90] from the true path. With released actions, the estimated path is 3.81 m [3.13, 4.51] from the true path and 3.62 m from the misread one; with repaired actions, it is 2.42 m [1.77, 3.12] and 4.06 m. Repaired predictions are therefore 1.39 m [0.89, 1.87] closer to the true path than released ones (18 of 20 trajectories). Measured as distance to the true path minus distance to the misread path, released predictions lean towards the misread path by only +0.19 m [ − - 0.29, +0.79] (9 of 20 trajectories nearer the misread path), while repaired predictions lean towards the true path by 1.64 m [1.00, 2.22] (1 of 20 nearer the misread path). Released predictions are nearer the true path at 4 s and nearer the misread one only by 16 s, so they leave the true path without clearly following the misread one. blocks.en: Geometric relative pose. As a check that does not depend on a learned model of motion, DISK features [ 38 ] matched with LightGlue [ 25 ] recover the relative pose between frame pairs, with a fisheye focal length fitted on training trajectories only. On real frames, they succeed on 83% of pairs, with a median yaw error of 2.4 ∘ . On generated frames of every fifth main-test clip (30 clips, 11 trajectories), they succeed on only 12% of released and 17% of repaired pairs. On chunks where the true and misread headings differ by at least 20 ∘ , released frames point 28.8 ∘ [8.6, 49.1] nearer the misread heading (7 of 9 trajectories), and repaired frames 30.1 ∘ [7.9, 55.5] nearer the true one (8 of 10). Coverage is low and may favour clearer frames, so we read this only as thin support. Together, the three tests support that repaired predictions follow the true path; that released predictions follow the misread path is supported only by this geometric check and, at 16 s, by the inverse dynamics model.

blocks.en: Section 7 audits 40 public repositories that had not been examined before each audit (Table 4); Table S2 lists them with their pinned commits. This section defines the terms used there, describes the two levels of the check and the three audits, and explains why most verdicts are weak tests. It ends with LCVN, the one mismatch that may reach an evaluation.
blocks.zh: 第7节审计了40个未在每次审计前审查的公共存放处(表4);表S2列出了这些存放处及其固定承付款。 本节定义了其中所使用的术语,描述了检查的两级和三项审计,并解释了为什么大多数判决都是薄弱的测试. 它以LCVN作为结尾,这是可能达到评价的一种不匹配.

blocks.en: Terms. The real columns are an encoder’s output columns exactly as its code produces them. A verdict is any comparison result on the real columns other than refusal: the two encoders are the same, show no observed difference, or differ. A mismatch is known when either level of the check or our reading found it; there is no ground truth for mismatches that all three missed.
blocks.zh: 条件 真实的列是编码器输出的列, 正好与其代码相同 。 一个判断是除拒绝以外的任何对真实列的比较结果:两个编码器是相同的,没有显示观察到的差异,或者不同. 当检查的级别或我们的读取结果发现时,就会发现不匹配;对于所有三个都错过的不匹配,没有依据的真理.

blocks.en: Two levels on real repositories. Of the 40 repositories, 28 derive actions from poses. ActRosetta’s family-free check, its first level, ran on 26 of them (all 8 from the first two audits and 18 of the 20 from the third); Senna and MAD use one function for both sides, so there was nothing to compare. On all five known mismatches (LogoNav’s Frodobot script, UMI’s timing pair, LCVN, ViPlanner and OpenDWM), the frozen code refused the real columns, and its refusal note recorded that the two encoders differ, which is the family-free check’s answer; a separate audit script, applying the same test, recorded the path on which the encoders differ. The check also flagged OccWorld, but only under a convention we assumed, so that case is not counted. The second level reached a verdict on the real columns for 14 of the 28. We began reporting the two levels separately only after the sealed tests.
blocks.zh: 真正的仓库有两个级别 在40个储存库中,28个储存库的动作来自姿势。 ActRosetta的无家庭支票,其第一级,在其中26起(前两次审计的8起和20起中的18起)上运行;Senna和MAD为双方使用一个功能,因此没有什么可比较的了. 在所有已知的5个错配(LogoNav的Frodobot脚本,UMI的计时对等,LCVN,ViPlanner和OpenDWM)上,被冻结的代码拒绝了真实的列,而其被冻结的注释记录了两个编码符的不同,这是无家庭检查的答案;一个单独的审计脚本,应用同样的测试,记录了编码符不同的路径. 检查也标出OccWorld, 但只是根据我们设想的公约, 所以这个案例不计在内。 第二层对28个中的14个栏目作出了裁决。 我们只是在密封测试之后 才开始单独报告这两级

blocks.en: First two audits. On eight public repositories not used before, ActRosetta reached a verdict on three. On eight more, whose list was fixed before any encoder code was read, it again reached a verdict on three (TransFuser, DiffusionDrive and PLUTO), all “no observed difference”. We also tried a wider contract family, designed on the first audit’s repositories. It raised the first audit’s verdicts from three to six, of which only four do not rest on our own assumptions or placeholder values, but it added no verdict in the second audit; all reported results therefore use the family of Sec. 4 with witness-backed naming. LogoNav’s mismatch, goal yaw converted to radians twice, is in a deployment script, not a model evaluation. UMI’s timing difference between training and deployment appears to be a deliberate design choice, so a detected difference is not necessarily a bug.
blocks.zh: 前两次审计。 在以前没有使用的8个公共存放处,Act Rosetta对3个作出了判决。 在另外8起事件中,在读取编码器编码之前,其清单已经固定,但再次对3起(TransFuser、DivusionDrive和PLUTO)作出判决,所有“没有观察到的差异”。 我们还尝试了在第一次审计的仓库上设计的更广泛的合同家庭。 它将第一次审计的判决从3个提高到6个,其中只有4个并不依赖于我们自己的假设或占位价值,但它没有在第二次审计中添加任何判决;因此,所有报告的结果都使用Sec. 4的家属来命名证人。 LogoNav的不匹配,目标yaw两次转换为弧度,是在部署脚本中,而不是模型评价. UMI在训练与部署之间的时间差异似乎是有意的设计选择,因此所检测出的差异并不一定是虫子.

blocks.en: Third audit. Before any encoder code was read, the list was fixed: the 16 repositories of the first two audits, followed by 24 new ones taken in salted-hash order from a pool of 48 that an automated agent had built, partly from memory. No listed repository was replaced. Commits are pinned, expected results were hashed before each run, and nothing was installed or imported; some encoders were transcribed by hand rather than executed. Of the 24 new repositories, 21 have complete code and 20 derive actions from poses. ActRosetta reached a verdict on the real columns for 8 of these 20, and for 11 if we may drop columns, and it named no field on real columns. The family-free check found 3 mismatches: one may affect evaluation (LCVN, provisional), one affects deployment only and looks intended (ViPlanner), and one is in code that never runs (OpenDWM). On the real columns of all five mismatches, including the two in previously examined repositories, ActRosetta refused. Among the 16 previously examined repositories, LogoNav and UMI showed deployment-only mismatches. LCVN comes from the same lab as UniWM, one of the first audit’s repositories, and its actor–critic code has an NWM path, so this one candidate does not show that such mismatches reach beyond NWM’s neighbourhood. Several repositories share lineage, so they are not independent, and three-dimensional motion was not modelled.
blocks.zh: 第三次审计。 在读出任何编码器代码之前,列表是固定的:前两次审计的16个寄存器,然后是24个新寄存器,取自一个自动代理所建造的48个池的盐-哈什订单,部分取自内存. 没有替换列表仓库 。 承诺被固定,预期结果在每次运行前被散列,没有安装或导入;有些编码器是通过手转录而不是执行的. 在24个新的储存库中,21个有完整的代码,20个从外表得到动作。 Act Rosetta对这20个栏目中的8个栏目和11个栏目做出了裁决,如果我们可以放下栏目的话,它就把栏目命名为正栏目中的任何栏目. 无家庭检查发现有3个错配:一个可能影响评价(LCVN,暂定),一个只影响部署和外观(ViPlanner),一个在代码中从未运行(OpenDWM). Act Rosetta拒绝了这五起错配事件, 在以前检查过的16个储存库中,LogoNav和联马特派团显示只部署不匹配。 LCVN与UniWM来自同一个实验室,UniWM是第一个审计的存储器之一,其演员–批评码有NWM路径,因此这个候选者并不能证明这种不匹配会超越NWM的邻里. 多个寄存器共享分系,因此它们不独立,三维运动也没有被模拟.

blocks.en: Why most verdicts are weak tests. Of the third audit’s 11 verdicts (counting those reached after dropping columns), 10 are “no difference” results that compare an encoder with our own inverse of the repository’s decoder or with one formula shared by both sides; LCVN is the exception. They therefore check little more than whether decoding inverts encoding.
blocks.zh: 为什么大多数判决都是微弱的测试. 在第三次审计的11项判决(计算在投放栏后作出的判决)中,10项是 " 无差别 " 的结果,将编码器与我们自己的存储器解码器或双方共同使用的一个公式进行比较;LCVN是例外。 因此,它们只检查是否对反向编码进行解码。

blocks.en: LCVN at the input level (post hoc). LCVN’s actor–critic policy learns in rollouts imagined by its world model, and by our reading these rollouts receive actions one row ahead of the world model’s training rows. No LCVN world-model or actor–critic checkpoint is public at the audited commit, so we could not measure an effect on predictions or on the policy. We instead read the released validation split (3,602 trajectories, each stored three times with identical data, so we cluster by trajectory) with a restricted unpickler and without network access. Its action field is the world-frame step p t + 1 − p t p_{t+1}-p_{t} with wrapped yaw change on all 3,602 trajectories, which confirms the convention our audit assumed. With true actions, the translation input the world model receives in actor–critic imagination differs from its training rows for the same frames by a median relative difference of 0.504 [0.501, 0.507] (mean absolute 0.075 m and 0.079 rad per row; 95% bootstrap over trajectories). About a third of this is structural, coming from one extra nonzero row; on the other rows, the median is 0.173 [0.170, 0.176] (exploratory).
blocks.zh: LCVN在输入级(后临时). LCVN的演员批评政策学习了它的世界模式所想象的推出,而我们通过阅读这些推出获得的行动比世界模式的训练排提前一行。 任何LCVN世界模式或角色批评检查点都不公开, 我们转而阅读了释放的验证分解(3,602道轨迹,每道轨迹存储了3次,数据相同,因此我们按轨迹分组),并有限制的不接取器,没有网络接入. 它的行动领域是世界范围的步骤p t + 1 - p → t p_{t+1} -p_{t] 在所有3,602道轨迹上包裹着w变化,这证实了我们的审计假设的公约. 随着真实的动作,世界模型在演员-批评性想象中得到的翻译输入与其对同帧的训练行不同,其相对相差中位数为0.504 [0.501,0.507] (每行平均绝对0.075米和0.079弧度;95%的靴子比轨迹差). 其中约三分之一是结构性的,来自一额外非零行;而其他行的中位数为0.173 [0.170,0.176] (探索).

blocks.en: A column rule that failed its check. ActRosetta refused LCVN’s real columns because one column, the time step, is constant. After seeing this, we wrote a generic rule that drops columns that are constant over the probe paths, locked it with a stop rule, and reran. On LCVN, it named the lag (training lag 2, rollout lag 1) and found no difference in the control pair. On the opened sealed sets, however, it added no false alarm but one wrong name and 49 crashes: on restricted paths, columns can look constant because of the paths rather than the encoder. By our locked stop rule, we do not claim the LCVN naming result.
blocks.zh: 列规则失败了 ActRosetta拒绝了LCVN的真正栏目,因为一个栏目,时间步骤是恒定的. 在看到这个之后,我们写了一个通用规则, 将恒定的柱子扔出在探针路径上, 用停止规则将其锁上,然后重放. 在LCVN上,它命名了后差(训练后差2,推出后差1),发现控制对无区别. 然而,在所打开的密封装置上,它没有添加假警报,而是增加了一个错误的名称和49个崩溃:在被限制的路径上,列可以因为路径而不是编码器而保持恒定. 根据锁定的停站规则,我们不声称LCVN命名结果.

blocks.en: Appendix H Command following in a simulator
blocks.zh: 模拟器中遵循的附录 H 命令

blocks.en: Better images need not mean better decisions. This section tests, outside NWM’s training domain, whether repaired actions make predictions follow commands more closely (Sec. 3, “Where repair matters”); Sec. Q reports a decision test and closed-loop tests. We used Habitat [ 31 ] with Matterport3D [ 7 ] scenes: 40 cases over 20 scenes, each with 8 candidate action sequences (8 frames at 4 fps), 50 diffusion steps and one seed. For each candidate, we asked whether NWM’s prediction is closest, by LPIPS, to the simulator’s real future for that candidate (chance 0.125). The repaired actions here were produced by ActRosetta’s adapter from the released outputs. Retrieval was only slightly above chance in both arms (0.172 released, 0.166 repaired), and repair showed no evidence of a change: − - 0.006 [ − - 0.066, 0.053] (95% scene-cluster bootstrap). A matching decision test on the same new scenes first checks that the task can show a benefit at all: with the simulator’s real futures in place of predictions (the oracle), choices must clearly beat a fixed always-forward baseline and shuffled futures. This oracle gate failed on these scenes, so by our locked rule we do not interpret the decision result. The earlier five-scene diagnostic of Sec. Q passed the same gate. We make no claim about control performance.
blocks.zh: 更好的形象并不一定意味着更好的决策。 本节在NWM的训练领域之外,测试修补过的动作是否使预测更紧密地遵循命令(第3节, " 凡修理重要 " ); 师曰. Q报告决定测试和闭路测试. 我们用"生境"[31]与"Matterport3D"[7]场景:40个案例超过20个场景,每个场景有8个候选动作序列(8个帧以4英尺平分),50个传播步骤和1个种子. 对每个候选人来说,我们问NWM的预测是否最接近模拟器对该候选人的真实未来(chance 0.125)。 由Act Rosetta的适配器制作, 在两只武器中,检索都略高于机会(已放出0.172个,已修复0.166个),修理没有显示任何变化的证据:--0.006 [--0.066,0.053] (95%的场景-集群靴子)。 在同一个新场景上进行匹配的决定测试首先检查任务能够显示出任何好处:随着模拟者真实的未来取而代之(即预言),选择必须明显地超越固定的向前基线和被打乱的未来. 这个神谕门在这些场景上失败了,所以根据我们锁定的规则,我们不解释决定结果. 早期对塞克. Q的五场诊断通过同一门. 我们不声称控制性能

blocks.en: Witness-backed naming has a few settings that we fixed before the final run. To show how much the final result depends on them, we varied one setting at a time on the opened final set (Table S3 ); these numbers show fragility and are not held-out evidence. Removing the whole naming rule lowers exact recovery from 73 to 68 of 91 and raises wrong names from 1 to 4. Removing only the witness requirement keeps recovery at 73 but doubles the wrong names to 2. A smaller witness margin also admits a second wrong name, and a larger one costs up to five exact recoveries. The two tolerances leave recovery at 73 and add one wrong name only at the loosest recovery tolerance, and rigid transformations of the probe paths move recovery between 70 and 73. blocks.en: Appendix N Noisy logs, active probing and cost
blocks.zh: 附录 N 噪音日志、活性探测和成本

blocks.en: This section describes two optional modes of ActRosetta, for noisy logs and for active probing, and its computational cost (Sec. 5). On the development interfaces, with declared noisy logs, ActRosetta answered 60–77% of 120 cases with no wrong answer (Sec. A ), and across the four sealed runs it was correct on 52 of 54 noisy pairs, with one wrong answer. On the development cases, the answers were also all correct without the stability gate defined below, so the benefit of the gate is not shown.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍Act Rosetta的两种可选模式,用于吵闹的日志和主动探测及其计算成本(第5节)。 在开发界面上,ActRosetta用被宣布的吵闹日志回答120个案件中的60–77 % 没有错误的回答(Sec. A),在被封的4个运行中,有54个吵闹对中的52个正确,有一个错误的回答. 关于发展案例,答案也是正确的,没有下面定义的稳定门,所以没有显示该门的好处.

blocks.en: Noisy logs. Exact tolerances are the wrong tool when logged poses differ from those the encoder saw. In noisy mode, which the user declares, ActRosetta refits on five perturbed probe sets. It answers only if the same hypothesis wins every time and the next behaviourally different hypothesis has at least 5 times the residual; we call these two conditions the stability gate , and when either fails it reports unsupported . If the best residual exceeds 2% of the output scale, it reports the encoder as outside the family. These values were fixed before the sealed tests.
blocks.zh: 噪y木. 准确的容忍度是错误的工具,当登录的姿势与所看到的编码器不同时。 在用户宣布的吵闹模式下,Act Rosetta在五套扰动探测器上重新配对. 只有在同一个假说每次都胜出, 而下一个行为上不同的假说至少拥有5倍的剩余部分时, 如果最佳剩余值超过产出尺度的2%,则报告编码器为家庭外. 这些值在被封存的测试前被固定.

blocks.en: Counterexample-guided probing. The active mode starts from one path. At each step, it queries the path from a pool that best separates the classes still accepted, or the probe kind linked to an unexcited field, and refits. Without noise, each query with a separating path removes at least one class, so for a finite family whose classes are pairwise separable on the pool, it ends with the right class after at most one query fewer than the number of classes. ActRosetta also returns each recovered contract as a YAML file, and witnesses can serve as unit tests.
blocks.zh: 反例入导出相. 活动模式从一个路径开始. 在每一个步骤,它都从一个能最好地区分仍然接受的类的池来询问路径,或者与未激动场相连接的探针类型,并重新适应. 没有噪音,每个带分离路径的查询都会去除至少一个类,因此对于一个在池上具有双向分离的有限度的家族来说,在最多一个查询少于类数后,就以正确的类结束. Act Rosetta还将每份收回的合同作为YAML文件退回,证人可以充当单位测试.

blocks.en: Cost. Position and yaw are fitted separately, so one recovery solves 720 + 420 720+420 small least-squares problems, with at most 3 unknowns per output, instead of a joint search over 720 × 420 = 302,400 720\times 420=302{,}400 hypotheses. Cost grows linearly with the number of hypotheses per part, and recovery needs no model weights or GPU. On the final sealed set, ActRosetta took a median of 0.58 s and 400 transitions per pair.
blocks.zh: 成本. 位置和yaw是分别安装的,所以一个回收可以解决720+420 720+420小最小平方的问题,每次输出最多有3个未知数,而不是联合搜索超过720×420=302400 720\times 420=302{,}400个假设. 成本随假设数逐一呈线性增长,恢复不需要模型权重或GPU. 在最后被封装的集合上,Act Rosetta取取了中位数为每对0.58 s和400个过渡.

blocks.en: Appendix O Baseline setup and real-code protocol
blocks.zh: 附录O 基线设置和真码协议

blocks.en: Sections 6 and 7 compare ActRosetta with baselines on the final sealed set (Table 3) and test it on real training–evaluation pairs. This section gives the baselines’ settings and the protocol for the real-code pairs (Table S5 ).
blocks.zh: 第6和7节将《罗塞塔法案》与最后密封套装的基线进行比较(表3),并测试真正的培训-评价对等。 本节给出了基线设置和真码对的协议(表S5 )。

blocks.en: Baseline setup. Random fuzzing calls both encoders on random paths (uniformly drawn per-step motions from a random start pose) at chunk sizes 1, 2 and 4, and reports a difference when an output differs by more than 10 − 6 10^{-6} , changes shape or raises an exception. The affine adapter (least squares) and an MLP adapter (two hidden layers of 64 ReLU units, trained with Adam) are fitted to map evaluation outputs to training outputs on the same budget of 280 transitions per pair. Each adapter sees the current evaluation row, the three previous rows and the chunk index, and is trained on paired evaluation and training outputs; ActRosetta needs no paired data. The baselines ran untuned, after the final set was opened. We did not measure the time a manual audit would take.
blocks.zh: 基线设置. 随机模糊调用在随机路径上的编码器(从随机起步姿势中统一抽取出每步动作),大小为1,2和4;如果输出值相差超过10 - 6 10 - 6 },则会改变形状或提出例外。 affine适配器(最东正方形)和一个MLP适配器(两层为64个RELU单元,由Adam培训)相接,用于将评价产出映射到每对280个过渡的同一预算上。 每个适配器可以看到当前评价行,前三行和块索引,并接受对等评价和培训产出的培训; Act Rosetta不需要对等数据. 在最后一套程序打开后,基线没有调整。 我们没有衡量人工审计所需时间。

The encoders of NWM, MWM, RAE-NWM, Vid2World, ViNT and World-in-World ran as the repositories’ own functions at pinned commits, on synthetic paths (ViNT is a development interface, Sec. blocks.en: Repair from NWM’s real outputs. On 20 real RECON clips, the path that the unrepaired NWM rollout’s actions command ends a median 7.57 m from the recorded endpoint, while the adapter, applied to those rollout outputs alone, reproduces the training tensors to 5.7 × 10 − 15 5.7\times 10^{-15} (Sec. 7).

blocks.en: Section 3 states that NWM’s planning code builds actions by a separate route that matches training at default settings. This section gives that check, a separate difference in how plans are scored, and an earlier planning test. All checks are on CPU, without the model, unless stated.
blocks.zh: 第3节指出,NWM的规划代码用一个单独的路径构建动作,在默认设置中匹配训练. 本节给出了这一检查,在计划如何得分上单独区别,以及更早的规划测试. 所有检查都在CPU上,没有模型,除非注明.

blocks.en: What the model receives. At the audited commit, planning does not use the mismatched rollout action encoder: planning_eval.py reads TrajectoryEvalDataset , and a plan is one normalized per-step displacement repeated 8 times. We ran its action builder on 500 plans drawn from the initial distribution of the cross-entropy method (CEM) [ 29 ] planner on RECON (seed 20261105) and compared the result with the training encoder. At stride 1, the setting in the repository’s README, the actions the model receives match training to floating-point precision, and ActRosetta reports no observed difference. Strides 2 and 4 sum normalized raw-step displacements, so the offset accumulates (largest row difference in x x : 0.333 and 1.000). The README does not use these strides, but a user who sets them gets a real mismatch.

blocks.en: How plans are scored. Planning then scores each plan’s absolute trajectory error (ATE) and relative pose error (RPE) along a straight line ( get_action_torch ), not along the path the model imagines. At stride 1, the largest row differences between the two paths are 0.205 ( x x ) and 0.353 ( y y ), and ActRosetta names frame on the scored path, with a witness of 8 transitions. This concerns how plans are scored, not what the model receives. A geometric analysis with no planner run (100 RECON start states from 36 trajectories, goal 2 s ahead, 95% trajectory bootstrap) shows its size. For the plan whose imagined endpoint reaches the goal, straight-line scoring gives an ATE of 0.79 [0.70, 0.87], against 0.50 [0.42, 0.57] along the imagined path, a gap of +0.29 [0.24, 0.35] waypoint units (0.07 m), and RPE rises by +0.10 [0.09, 0.12]. Over 120 random candidates per state, ATE rankings under the two scorings agree with Kendall’s τ \tau of 0.76 [0.75, 0.78]. CEM ranks candidates by LPIPS, not ATE, so these ranking changes do not act on the planner directly. For near-ideal plans this scoring would penalize NWM’s ATE, but real CEM plans are not ideal, so its effect on NWM’s planning table is unmeasured. The NWM + NoMaD rows of that table cannot be audited, as their code is not in the repository.
blocks.zh: 计划如何得分. 然后,计划沿直线(获得_action_torch)对每个计划的绝对轨迹误差(ATE)和相对出错(RPE)进行评分,而不是沿着模型所想的道路进行。 在步道一上,两条道相差最大的一行是0.205 (x x)和0.353 (y y),而Act Rosetta names frame 在得分道扬镳的道上,有8个过渡的见证. 这涉及到计划如何得分,而不是模型得到什么. 一项没有计划员运行的几何分析(100 RECON从36个轨迹开始状态,目标2 s 前进,95%的轨迹靴子)显示其大小. 对于所想象的终点已经达到目标的计划,直线得分给出了0.79分[0.70,0.87]的ATE,相较于所想象的路径上0.50分[0.42,0.57],相差为+0.29分[0.24,0.35分]的路由点单位(0.07米),而RPE则上升了+0.10分[0.09,0.12分]. 每个州超过120名随机候选人,两个得分下的ATE排名与肯德尔的\tau 0.76[0.75,0.78]一致. CEM通过LPIPS对候选人进行排名,而不是ATE,因此这些排名变化并不直接对规划者采取行动. 对于近乎理想的计划来说,这一评分会惩罚NWM的ATE,但真正的CEM计划并不理想,因此它对NWM的规划表的影响是没有衡量的. 该表的NWM + NoMaD行无法审计,因为它们的代码不在寄存器中.

An earlier offline planning test with the model (20 cases from 18 trajectory clusters, 20 candidates, three seeds, 250 diffusion steps, 2,400 rollouts) found no planning effect of repaired actions: released minus repaired endpoint error was − - 0.0077 m (95% trajectory t t interval [ − - 0.0748, +0.0594]). blocks.en: Section 3 reports that repair does not measurably improve command following (40 cases; Sec. H ) or image-goal decisions (20 cases, two runs). This section gives the decision test, a closed-loop test in World-in-World [ 43 ] , which places NWM inside tasks where its predictions guide an agent, and two tests of the context frames. Together they show no measurable benefit of repair for decisions, at sample sizes that cannot exclude small effects.
blocks.zh: 第3节报告说,在作出40个案件(H.Sec.H.)或图像目标决定(20个案件,2个运行)之后,修复无法明显改善指挥。 本节给出了决定测试,World-in-World [43] 的闭路测试,将NWM置于其预测引导一种剂的任务之内,以及上下文框的两次测试. 两者加在一起表明,无法以无法排除小效果的样本大小来衡量对决策的修复是否有好处。

blocks.en: Image-goal decisions. This diagnostic in Habitat with Matterport3D scenes (20 cases in five scenes, eight fixed candidates of 8 transitions each, an LPIPS score on the final image, and regret : the geodesic distance from the chosen candidate’s endpoint to the goal minus the smallest such distance among the eight candidates, in metres) first had to pass an oracle gate: with the simulator’s real futures in place of predictions, choices must beat simple baselines. On these five scenes it passed: regret fell by 0.4962 m [0.4271, 0.6107] against a fixed always-forward baseline and by 0.9300 m [0.6765, 1.1834] against shuffled futures. (On the 20 new scenes of Sec. H , the same gate failed.) With NWM’s predictions (960 rollouts per run, three paired seeds, 50 diffusion steps), repair did not reduce regret: released minus repaired was − - 0.1197 m [ − - 0.2352, − - 0.0006] in the first run and − - 0.1487 m [ − - 0.3035, 0.0213] in a replication with new cases on the same scenes (95% scene-cluster bootstrap). Both point estimates favour released actions, and the first run’s bootstrap interval lies just below zero. With only five scene clusters, however, the scene-level t t intervals ([ − - 0.3086, 0.0691] and [ − - 0.4123, 0.1149]) include zero, and the replication’s includes the +0.10 m effect we had set in advance as useful. We therefore claim neither a benefit nor a general harm of repair in this diagnostic. Collisions, repeated stationary context frames and the simulator’s domain shift limit what this says about the action interface. A pipeline check found that the decision loop’s rollouts equal those of the released generator exactly (18 of 18 tensors).

blocks.en: World-in-World, Active Recognition. World-in-World’s conversion of NWM actions drops the normalization offset (Table S5 ). On the first 100 episodes of a seeded permutation of its 551 Active Recognition episodes (26 scenes), with NWM at 50 diffusion steps, seed 0, and a Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 4 ] planner at temperature 0, success was 28 of 100 with World-in-World’s actions and 28 of 100 with repaired ones; the planner alone, without NWM, scored 31 of 100. No episode differed in outcome (exact McNemar p = 1.0 p=1.0 ). The scene-cluster bootstrap interval of the difference is degenerate ([0.000, 0.000]); if episodes are treated as independent, 0 discordant episodes of 100 exclude a change above about 3.6 percentage points (95% Clopper–Pearson). This is no evidence of a change at this sample size, which is not evidence of no effect. World-in-World runs NWM at 50 rather than 250 diffusion steps; on one episode with ten calls, the DreamSim difference between 50 and 250 diffusion steps was no larger than that between two 250-step samples with different noise ( − - 0.028 [ − - 0.068, +0.006]).
