blocks.en: This section reports checks that support Sec. 3 but that its claims do not rely on, and two directions that did not work.
blocks.zh: 本节报告检查了支持第3条的,但其索赔不依赖,以及两个不可行的方向。

blocks.en: Repair on previously examined trajectories. On 50 RECON clips from 20 previously examined trajectories (three seeds, 250 diffusion steps), repair lowered mean DreamSim error from 0.2324 to 0.1375, a reduction of 0.0949 [0.0554, 0.1343] (98.3% t t interval over trajectory means, Bonferroni-adjusted for the three tests of the same locked suite; Sec. Q ). These trajectories had been examined before, so this is a robustness check, not an independent replication.
blocks.zh: 修复以前检查过的轨迹。 在50个RECON剪接器上,从以前检查过的20个出轨(3个种子,250个扩散步骤),修理将平均DreamSim误差从0.2324降至0.1375,减少0.0949 [0.0554,0.1343] (98.3% t t 相差于轨迹表示,Bonferroni-为同一锁定套房的三次测试而调整;Sec.Q.). 这些轨迹以前就已经检查过了,所以这是一个坚固性的检查,而不是独立的复制.

blocks.en: MWM on SCAND. MWM [ 41 ] builds on NWM and shares its rollout mismatches (Sec. 7). On NWM’s SCAND split (150 clips, 13 trajectories, 1 fps, 16 s, seed 0), MWM, run from its released LoRA weights [ 19 ] at 5 diffusion steps, leads NWM at 5 diffusion steps by DreamSim +0.179 [+0.139, +0.207] with released actions and +0.166 [+0.125, +0.199] with repaired ones. The mismatch thus inflated MWM’s advantage by +0.012 [+0.002, +0.024], about 7%, and the advantage survives. MWM’s paper also reports that MWM at 5 diffusion steps beats NWM at 25; with the released weights, they tie on DreamSim ( − - 0.003 [ − - 0.024, +0.013] with released actions), and NWM at 25 diffusion steps is better on LPIPS by 0.063 [0.053, 0.073]. Possible causes are untested: the released LoRA weights are rank 16 on all linear layers, unlike the paper’s description; our SCAND copy and resolution may differ; and MWM’s evaluation samples without a fixed seed. This is therefore a reproducibility question, not a claim of error.
blocks.zh: MWM在SCAND上。 MWM [41] 以NWM为基础,并分享其推出不匹配之处(第7节)。 在NWM的SCAND分出上(150个剪辑,13个轨迹,1个英尺,16个秒,种子0个),MWM在5个扩散步骤上从所释放的LORA重量[19]跑出,由DreamSim+0.179 [+0.139,+0.207]在5个扩散步骤上领先NWM,并有放出动作和被修复动作的+0.166 [+0.125,+0.199]. 因此,这种不匹配将MWM的优势放大了+0.012 [+0.002,+0.024],约7%,优势得以存活. MWM的论文还报告说,MWM在5个扩散步骤上比NWM在25比;随着所释放的重量,它们与DreamSim(--0.003 [----0.024,+0.013] 绑起已释放动作),而NWM在25个扩散步骤上比LPIPS在0.063 [0.053,0.073]更好. 可能的原因没有经过测试:释放的LORA重量在所有线性地层上排在第16位,与纸张描述不同;我们的SCAND副本和分辨率可能不同;MWM的评价样本没有固定的种子. 因此,这是一个可复制性问题,而不是关于错误的说法。

blocks.en: Vid2World pilot. On 10 RECON clips (9 trajectories, 50 diffusion steps, 16 frames at 4 fps; seeds 0 and 1 for the clip’s own actions, seed 0 for the substituted ones), substituting another clip’s actions changed Vid2World’s frames 2.308 [1.933, 2.752] times as much as a new seed did (DreamSim), and more on all 10 clips. This was a descriptive pilot; the locked 12-clip version is in Sec. C .
blocks.zh: Vid2World飞行员. 在10个RECON剪辑上(9个出轨,50个扩散步骤,16个帧为4英尺;0和1个种子用于剪辑自己的动作,0个种子用于被替换的动作),取而代之的是另一个剪辑的动作改变了Vid2World的2.308个帧[1.933,2.752]倍于一个新的种子(DreamSim),更多的是所有10个剪辑. 这是一个描述性飞行员;锁定的12clip版本在Sec.C.。

blocks.en: A learned pose estimator. Before the inverse dynamics model and feature matching of Sec. F , we tried to measure motion in predictions with VGGT-1B [ 39 ] , testing it first on ground-truth frames (50 clips per dataset, 800 frame transitions, 95% trajectory bootstrap). It failed its locked gate on both datasets: the median per-step yaw error was 13.2 ∘ [10.6, 15.8] on RECON and 14.7 ∘ [12.5, 17.8] on Go Stanford, against a limit of 5 ∘ , and the yaw slope was 0.378 [0.232, 0.592] and 0.284 [0.154, 0.416], against a required interval inside [0.8, 1.2]. Six variants with denser frames or joint multi-frame windows (groups of frames processed together) also failed, so we did not use this route.
blocks.zh: 一个有学识的姿势估计师。 在Sec.F的反向动态模型和特征匹配之前,我们试图用VGGT-1B [39] 的预测来测量运动,首先在地上真实框架上进行测试(每套数据集50个剪接,800个帧过渡,95%的轨迹靴子). 它在两个数据集上都没有成功锁定出闸:RECON的每步姚错中位数为13.2分[10.6分,15.8分],Go Stanford的为14.7分[12.5分,17.8分],限值为5分;而 ya斜度为0.378分[0.232分,0.592分]和0.284分[0.154分,0.416分],需要间隔为[0.8分,1.2分]. 有6个更密集的帧或联合多帧窗口(一组帧一起处理)的变体也失败了,因此我们没有使用这个路由.

blocks.en: Uncertainty from sample spread. We also tested whether the spread of sampled futures (8 per clip, 50 clips per dataset) indicates prediction error. Spread predicted error at the same prediction time across clips (AUROC 0.71–0.91 on RECON and 0.53–0.77 on Go Stanford), but not later error (AUROC 0.50–0.57). In a ranking test with a shared start (30 RECON start states, 16 candidates each), adding spread to the cost never helped: cross-validation chose zero weight in every fold. We computed no intervals for these AUROCs. This direction was negative.
blocks.zh: 样本传播的不确定性。 我们还测试了样本期货的传播(每集8个,每集50个)是否表明预测出错. 在同一预测时间将预测出的错误分散到相隔的片段(RECON上的AUROC 0.71–0.91和Go Stanford上的0.53–0.77),但以后不会出错(AUROC 0.50–0.57). 在共享起步的排名测试中(RECON起步状态为30个,各有16个入选者),在成本中加入差分从未帮助过:交叉验证在每个折叠中选择了零重. 我们没有计算这些AUROC的间隔。 这个方向是负面的。

blocks.en: Pulling inputs back into range. Projecting released rows into the training range, in whitened coordinates, cuts error by 0.052 [0.012, 0.075]. It also moves the commanded path, however: the share of the path error it removes (0.26) lies within the interval of the share of the released-action damage it removes (0.52 [0.15, 0.67]), so the two effects cannot be separated. A simple per-axis clip helps as much while leaving 79% of rows out of range, so being in range is not the whole story. The projection leaves the error of repaired rows unchanged (+0.0001).

blocks.en: Regression over all arms. Over 15,750 chunk-level observations from all arms of this study, damage rises both with the commanded path’s error and with the accumulated out-of-range score, each with the other held fixed (standardized coefficients 0.50 [0.47, 0.54] and 0.36 [0.33, 0.42]; R 2 R^{2} 0.38). blocks.en: Predicting damage in advance. With five combinations, this is weak evidence.

blocks.en: Section 3 tests whether sensitivity to action encoding extends beyond NWM by injecting faults into EgoWM [ 3 ] and RAE-NWM [ 44 ] . This section gives the design, the fault definitions, the full results (Table S6 ) and each model’s action responsiveness. The injected faults are expressed in each model’s own action convention; they are not bugs in either model’s released code.
blocks.zh: 第3节通过向EgoWM[3]和RAE-NWM[44]注射断层,检验对动作编码的敏感性是否超越了NWM. 本节给出了设计,断层定义,全部结果(表S6)以及每个模型的动作响应性. 注入的断层在每一个模型自己的行动公约中都有表示;它们不是两个模型中都发布的代码中的错误.

blocks.en: Design. We fixed the protocol before generation, and the addition of seeds 1–2 before their generation and regardless of the seed-0 results (recorded locally, not publicly registered). Automated agents ran the study, and no one outside the team replicated it. We use the 90 RECON clips of Sec. M (19 trajectories) and 16 generated frames at 4 fps, with each model’s settings unchanged. EgoWM uses one context frame and RAE-NWM four. Seed 0 ran on one RTX 3090 Ti; seeds 1–2 ran on A100 GPUs, with correct actions regenerated there. Each fault-minus-correct contrast pairs the same clip, seed and GPU type.
blocks.zh: 设计. 我们先制定协议,然后在种子1–2产生前添加种子1–2,不管种子0的结果如何(在当地录制,没有公开注册). 自动化特工主持研究,团队外无人复制. 我们使用Sec.M的90个RECON剪辑(19个轨迹)和在4英尺处生成的16个帧,每个模型的设置不变. EgoWM使用一个上下文框架和RAE-NWM 4. 种子0跑在一个RTX 3090上 Ti;种子1–2运行在A100 GPU上,在那里重新生成正确的动作. 每个断层-减去正反对对相同剪接,种子和GPU类型.

blocks.en: Fault definitions. EgoWM’s inference action convention matches NWM’s training convention, so the frame and offset faults map directly. RAE-NWM already rotates displacements, normalizes without an offset and wraps yaw. Its offset fault is therefore redefined as the same physical perturbation, 0.3125 m of extra forward motion per step after the first, and its 2 ​ π 2\pi fault is applied at the model input after its own wrapping. No clip crosses the yaw-wrap boundary within 4 s, so the combined fault is frame plus offset, and NWM’s natural yaw mismatch is not tested. The 2 ​ π 2\pi fault changes the representation but preserves the commanded path.

Analysis and results. DreamSim is the primary metric and LPIPS (AlexNet features) the secondary, both computed on the same shared image view and with the same scorer as the comparison in Sec. M . For the A100 column we average seeds within clips, then bootstrap trajectories with 10,000 resamples (seed 20261007), using the ratio of sums. Holm correction covers eight tests (two models, four faults), separately for each metric and GPU type. Every injected fault harms image accuracy on each GPU type (Table S6 ), and every seed alone agrees in direction. LPIPS confirms all eight, also with corrected p = 0.0016 p=0.0016 ; its combined-fault increases are 0.0610 [0.0507, 0.0725] for EgoWM and 0.0792 [0.0689, 0.0897] for RAE-NWM at seed 0, and 0.0588 [0.0502, 0.0689] and 0.0825 [0.0750, 0.0911] on the A100s. The 2 ​ π 2\pi fault causes the largest damage in both models even though it leaves the commanded path unchanged. This supports sensitivity to how actions are represented, not a claim about control success.

LPIPS确认所有8个,并有更正后p=0.0016 p=0.0016;其合并故障增加值为:EgoWM为0.0610 [0.0507,0.0725];RAE-NWM为0.0792 [0.0689,0.0897],种子为0;A100为0.0588 [0.0502,0.0689]和0.0825 [0.0750,0.0911]. 2π2\pi断层造成两种型号中最大的破坏,尽管它使所指令的路径保持不变. 这支持对行动如何表现的敏感性,而不是声称控制成功。

Both lower bounds exceed the 1.5 threshold fixed in advance. Unlike the NWM and Vid2World ratios of Secs. B and C , these use one seed for the substituted actions and one seed pair for noise. Across NWM, Vid2World, EgoWM and RAE-NWM, the protocol’s descriptive comparison of responsiveness (2.25, 2.54, 2.410 and 1.844) with harm (0.0209, 0.0586, 0.0292 and 0.0333) gives a Spearman rank correlation of 0.4. Here NWM’s harm is its released-minus-repaired difference from Sec. M and Vid2World’s is its missing-offset fault from Sec. C . Different clips, horizons and fault definitions preclude any claim of a general relationship.

blocks.en: Checks and limitations. All required arms have finite 16-frame scores on all 90 clips. Seed-0 predictions with correct actions reuse earlier outputs from the same machine only after exact pixel reproduction, and their recomputed scores match exactly; repeated A100 clips also match exactly. Independent arithmetic and cluster-bootstrap checks reproduce the fault contrasts and responsiveness intervals. With correct actions and the same seed, the mean absolute DreamSim difference between the RTX 3090 Ti and the A100s is about 0.0001 for EgoWM and 0.0068–0.0070 for RAE-NWM, but no primary contrast crosses GPU types. A planned secondary readout, the direct spread between A100 seeds, is available only for RAE-NWM (0.0824), because EgoWM’s seeds were scored in separate sessions, and we form no A100 responsiveness ratio. The evidence is limited to RECON, 4 s clips and injected faults; we make no claim about the alternative models’ published scores or about downstream planning.
blocks.zh: 检查和限制。 所有所需武器在90个弹夹上都有16个分数。 种子-0的预测,只有经过精确的像素复制后,才会有正确的动作再利用同一机器的更早输出,其重制得分完全吻合;重复的A100片段也完全吻合. 独立的算术和集束波纹检查复制了断层对比和反应间隔。 有了正确的动作和相同的种子,RTX 3090 Ti和A100s之间的平均绝对DreamSim的相差大约为:EgoWM0.0001和RAE-NWM0.068–0.0070,但没有主对比交叉GPU类型. 由于EgoWM的种子在不同的会话中得分,我们没有形成A100反应率,因此计划进行的二级读取,即A100种子之间的直接传播,只能用于RAE-NWM(0.0824). 证据仅限于RECON、4个短片和注射断层;我们没有就替代模型公布的分数或下游规划提出任何主张。
